reference: Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduasa nnum, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduonu nnum wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Ɔbedoe hɛn no na wɔde mfie aduasa no mu. Na ɔde hwene mfiehyia aduonu nnum wɔ Yɛresalam.

reference: Na Manoa ka kyerɛɛ AWURADE bɔfoɔ no sɛ: Wo din de sɛn?
hypothesis: Amanoa aka kyerɛ adebɔfoɔ no sɛ wɔdi ndesɛn.

reference: Na Konania nso ne ne nuanom Semaia, Netanel, Hasabia, Yeiel ne Yosabad, Lewifoɔ asafohene no yii Twam nnwan mpemnum ne anantwie ahanum maa Lewifoɔ no.
hypothesis: Nkonnwa nnuanso ne ne nuanom si maya, ne taeɛ, kasabea, yia ne yosaba. Lɔwifoɔ asafoɔ hɛn no yie twam nnwan, mpem nnum ne anantwie ahanum ma lɔwifoɔ no.

reference: Na afoforɔ bi nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ atwerɛfoɔ, mpanimfoɔ ne aponoanohwɛfoɔ.
hypothesis: Afoforɔ bi yɛ adwuma sɛ atwerɛfoɔ. Mpanimfoɔ ne apono ano hwɛfoɔ.

reference: Na wɔrefiri adie no, Yehosafat gyinae na ɔkaa sɛ: Yuda ne Yerusalemfoɔ, montie me.
hypothesis: Nna wofiri adie no, yɛhosa fɔt gyina na ɔka asɛe. Yɛda ne yɛr sɛlɛmfoɔ, munti emi.

reference: Ɛnna Amasia bisaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Na ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha a mede ama Israel asafo no?
hypothesis: Ɛna amɛsia bi saa nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ. Nea ɔde anigye kɛseɛ ɔhaa ma de ama ɛduruwae asafo no.

reference: Afei, me Nyankopɔn, ma w’aniwa mmue ɛ, na yɛ aso ma ɛha yi mpaebɔ.
hypothesis: Afei manyaangopɔn ma wɔn aniwa mu yɛ n'ayɛ asoɔ ma ɛhaen paeɛbɔ.

reference: Na adeɛ biara a AWURADE Nyankopɔn agye de ama yɛn sɛ yɛnni soɔ no, ɛno na yɛbɛfa adi soɔ.
hypothesis: Adeɛ bi a awurade nyanko pɔn agye de ama yɛn sɛ yɛn nsuo no. Ɛno na ɛbɛfa adi soɔ.

reference: Ɛberɛ a wɔhyɛɛ mo so no, mosu frɛɛ me na megyee mo.
hypothesis: Ɛbera wɔ hyɛɛm so no, mu so firɛɛm naame gya mu.

reference: Na ɔfaa bi kura kɔe, na ɔrekorɔ na ɔredi, na ɔkɔduruu n’agya ne ne na nkyɛn, na ɔmaa wɔn bi dii; nanso wanka ankyerɛ wɔn sɛ gyata no yam na ɔyii ɛwoɔ no.
hypothesis: Ɔfra bi kura kɔɔe na ɔkorɔ na ɔredi. Na ɔkɔ duru ne gya no nenam nkyɛn. Na ɔma wɔn bi deɛ, na nso wɔn nkɛntene a ɔhyɛ gyata no yam na ɔyi ɛwoɔ no.

reference: Ntotorobɛntohyɛnfoɔ ne nnwomtofoɔ no nyinaa bɔɔ mu too dwom de kamfoo Awurade, daa no ase.
hypothesis: Totobɛnto hyɛmfoɔ ne nnwomtofoɔ no nyinaa abɔ ɔmo to dwom de kaafoɔ awuade da no ase.

reference: Yehoram nuanom mmarima a na wɔyɛ Yehosafat mmammarima foforɔ bi no ne Asaria, Yehiel, Sakaria, Asaria, Mikael ne Sefatia.
hypothesis: Gyehoro amnea ne mmarima a ɔyɛ USA Fadima mmarima foforɔ bi ne asɛwia, yehia, sakariya, asɛwia, nika ne safatea.

reference: Na Samson frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, afei kae me, na hyɛ me den prɛko pɛ yi nko ara, Onyankopɔn, na mentɔ m’ani mmienu yi so were prɛko Filistifoɔ so.
hypothesis: Asam sɛm frɛwura de sɛ ɛwura de nyankopɔn afei kae me. Ne hyɛm de prɛko panyinkoa. Ɔnyankopɔn na mentɔ mmienu yi nso reyɛ prɛko filisifoɔ so.

reference: Ɛnyɛ wo so na mebaa nnɛ, na mmom efie a ɛne me di ako no so na Onyankopɔn aka sɛ menyɛ ntɛm.
hypothesis: Nya wɔ so na mebaa nɛ. Na emu efie a anim di akon no so na ɔnyɛ akokɔn akɛse me nyɛ ntam.

reference: Na ne ba Manase bɛdii n’adeɛ.
hypothesis: Nna ne ba ma n'ase bɛdii na adeɛ.

reference: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ firi Gilgal baa Bokim bɛkaa sɛ: Meyii mo firii Misraim na mede mo baa asase a mekaa ho ntam mekyerɛɛ mo agyanom no so, na mese: Meremmu me ne mo ntam apam no so da biara da.
hypothesis: Nnwadzebɔfoɔ firi geeguaba a bokim bɛka asɛ. Meyinim firi mu zoom, na meyɛ dɛmɔbaa asase a ne kan aho ntam no kyerɛ mu agyanom no so. Na meyɛ sɛ, meyimu me ne mu ntam apam no so dɛɛmɛ adan.

reference: Ɔduruu ɔbarima no ho no, ɔbisaa no sɛ, “Wo na wokaa biribi kyerɛɛ me yere no anaa?
hypothesis: Oduro ɔbarima no ho no, obisa no sɛ, wɔn a wɔka biribi kyerɛ me yere no anaa. Ɔboa sɛ, aane ɛyɛmɛ. Ntoma no a obisa no sɛ, sɛ nsɛm a .

reference: Enti obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ wiase adamfoɔ no gyina hɔ sɛ Nyankopɔn tamfo.
hypothesis: Nti obiara ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ wiase adanfoɔ no gyina hɔ sɛ wɔn nyanko pɔntaamfoɔ.

reference: Na wammrɛ ne ho ase AWURADE anim sɛdeɛ n’agya Manase brɛɛ ne ho aseɛ no, na ɔno Amon maa mfomsoɔ dɔɔso.
hypothesis: Wɔammerɛn ho aseɛ wura adeɛ anim sɛdeɛ no agya ama no ase berɛn ho aseɛ no. Na ɔno ama ɔmanfom soɔdɔɔso.

reference: Na asɔfoɔ no antumi anhyɛne AWURADE dan no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE animuonyam no ayɛ AWURADE dan no ma.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ no a ntumi ayɛ sɛne ɛwuradedan no mu afiri sɛɛ na ɛwuradie no mu ndzɛm ayɛ ɛwuradedan no mu.

reference: Ɛne Onyankopɔn a ɔka me ho no nnni asie, na wansɛe wo.
hypothesis: Anipa ne mpɔ a ɔka me ho no nni asie na wansɛɛ wɔn.

reference: Na Usia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn ahemfo asieeɛ asase no so, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɔyaree kwata.
hypothesis: Nsia te ne gya no wɔ asa mmaa do. Na wɔsia ne gya no mu nkyɛn ahenfoɔ esia yɛ asaase no so. Na wɔka asɛ ɔyere kwata.

reference: Na Yudafoɔ boaboaa wɔn ano sɛ wɔrebɛhwehwɛ AWURADE hɔ mmoa.
hypothesis: Awurafoɔ aboaboa wɔn ano sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ awuraade hɔ mmoa.

reference: Na afei adɛn na moka kyerɛ me sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ɛreyɛ woɔ, yi?
hypothesis: Aha yi adanam kakra mu sɛ ɛdan na ɛyɛ wui.

reference: “Ɔsɔfopanin Amaria bɛyɛ mo panin, na ɔkasa a obi nka bi bio wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa Awurade ho nyinaa.
hypothesis: Asɔnoppanin amari abɛyɛ mu panin, na ɔkasa a obi nka bi rebue wɔn nsam a ɛfa aduade ho nyinaa.

reference: Ne babarima Hesekia na ɔdii nʼadeɛ sɛ ɔhene.
hypothesis: Nnipa barima ahasekia na odi nyinaa deɛ sɛ ɔhene.

reference: Ano korɔ no ara mu na nkamfo ne nnome firi ba.
hypothesis: Anɔkorɔ no ara mu na nkaafoɔ ne nnum efiri ba.

reference: Bosome a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu na wɔfirii akuakuo no aseɛ, na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no mu na wɔwieeɛ.
hypothesis: Bosumi a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu na wofiri akuoakuo no ase. Na bosumi a ɛtɔ so nsuo no mu na wɔwie.

reference: Ɔyɛ ɔbaa bi a ɔfiri Dan mmammaa mu ba, na n’agya yɛ Tironi.
hypothesis: Ɛyɛ ɔbaa bi a ɔfiri dan ma maa mu ba. Anagya yɛ tiri nni.

reference: Ɛfiri sɛ wɔaka ntankɛseɛ agu deɛ wamma AWURADE nkyɛn Mispa no so sɛ: Kum na wɔnku no.
hypothesis: Efi sɛ wakantan kɛseɛ agudeɛ a wama wɔde nkyɛn. Mesepa no nso sɛ kum na wɔn kum no.

reference: Wobɛnyinsɛn na woawo ɔbabarima, na hwɛ sɛ oyiwan nka ne tire, ɛfiri sɛ, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Nasareni a wɔayi no asi hɔ ama Onyankopɔn firi awoɔ mu.
hypothesis: Wɔbanyin sɛn na wɔawɔ ɔbaa barima. Na hwɛ sɛ ɔyi wɔn nka ne tiri. Efir sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɔyɛ n'adzerɛni a wɔyi no asi hɔ ama onyanko pɔn firi awoɔ mu.

reference: Efraimfoɔ ntuanofoɔ no buaa sɛ, “Gileadfoɔ nyɛ nnipa biara sɛ adwanefoɔ a wɔfiri Efraim ne Manase.
hypothesis: Efiri mfoɔ ntoa no foɔ no bo ase. Gileadfoɔ ɛnyɛ nnipa biara sɛ adwanefoɔ a wɔfiri efiri mu ne ma no ase.

reference: Wɔyɛɛ wɔn adwene sɛ wɔbɛgya Awurade, wɔn agyanom Onyankopɔn Asɔredan no, na wɔasom Asera afɔrebukyia no ne ahoni no mmom.
hypothesis: Wɔyɛ wɔn adwene sɛ wɔbɛgya awuade wɔ gyanom nyɛnko pɔ asɔre dan no. Wɔasɔ asraafoɔ rebikyia no ne ahonin no mu.

reference: Na Hesekia hunuu sɛ Sanaherib aba na n’ani wɔ so sɛ ɔne Yerusalem rebɛko no, ɔne ne mmapɔmma ne n’atumfoɔ tuu agyina sɛ wɔbɛsisi nsuo aniwa a ɛwowɔ kuro no ho no; na wɔboaa no.
hypothesis: Nnɔhɛdzeke ahorow sɛ sanaharim aba na n'aniwa so sɛ ɔne yɛresan baako no. Ɔne ne mapɔɔma ne n'atumfoɔ tuo gyina asɛe. Wɔbɛ sisi nsuo aniwa a ɛwɔ kuro no ho no, na wɔboa ano.

reference: Nso asɔfoɔ no mu mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ɔman no maa wɔn mmarato dɔɔso pii sɛ wiase amanaman akyiwadeɛ nyinaa, na wɔguu AWURADE fie a wayɛ no kronkron Yerusalem no ho fi.
hypothesis: Nsuasɔfoɔ no mu mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ɔman no ma wɔ mmeratoɔdɔɔ so pii sɛ wiase ama maekyewa adeɛ nyinaa. Na wɔgu awuade fie a wɔayɛ no kronkron yɛresaw no ho fie.

reference: Asɔfoɔ no deɛ, na Ɛpo no ankasa mu nsuo na na wɔde hohoro wɔn ho, na wɔmmfa dwaresɛn no mu nsuo no bi.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ no deɛ, na ɛpo no ankasa mu nsuo na na wɔde hohoro wɔn ho na wɔn fa dware sɛn no mu nsuo no bi.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne teaseɛnamkafoɔ no sɛ: Dane w’ani na fa me firi ɛdɔm yi mu, na mapira.
hypothesis: Ɔkaakyerɛ nɛtease a ɛnam kaafoɔ no sɛ. Dan wɔn ani, n'afame firi ɛdɔm yi mu. Na mmapira.

reference: Na Ɔhene Salomo de anantwie mpemaduonu mmienu ne nnwan mpemha aduonu bɔɔ okum afɔdeɛ, na ɔhene ne ɔman no nyinaa dwiraa Nyankopɔn fie no ho.
hypothesis: Ɔhene sɛlɔmɔ de anantwie mpem aduonu mmienu ne nnua mpem ha aduonu bɔ okum afɔdeɛ. Na ɔhene ne ɔman no nyinaa adwira nyankopɔn fie no ho.

reference: Na ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Monnku no wɔ AWURADE fie.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ no kaase, munku no wɔ awurade fie.

reference: Yefta bisaa wɔn sɛ, “Ɛnyɛ mo na motane me, pamoo me firii mʼagya fie no?
hypothesis: Yɛftɛ bi saa wɔn sɛ ɛnyɛ mu na ɛmota no me ɛpɔmɔ mu firi bɛgyafie no.

reference: Yɛbɛyɛ sɛdeɛ woka biara.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa a nnipa no nyinaa nso di foɔ anaa. Giller de ntoa no foɔ no boa no sɛ, ɛwuradie no yɛ danseni. Yɛbɛɛ sɛ dɛ wɔka biara.

reference: Na ɔhene no ne ne mmapɔmma ne badwa no nyinaa atu agyina wɔ Yerusalem sɛ wɔbɛdi Twam bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no so.
hypothesis: Ɔhene ne ne mma mmaa mmaa ne badwa no nyinaa atu agyina wɔ yɛresalamsey. Wɔbɛdi twam bosumi a ɛtɔ so mmienu no so.

reference: Na Hesekia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no Dawid mma asieeɛ deɛ ɛkorɔn, na Yuda ne Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa dii no ni wɔ ne wuo mu.
hypothesis: Ahaadzi kiate ne gya no mu wɔ asa man do. Na wɔsie no dɛwidie ma asi deɛ ɛkorɔ. Na yuudane yɛreslɛmfoɔ nyinaa di no ni. Wɔne wɔn mu.

reference: Yehoahas dii mfeɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene abosome mmiɛnsa wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Yehu ahadze mfie aduaduadu mmiɛnsa na obedzi hwene. Na odzi hwene abɔsorɔ mmiɛnsa wɔ yɛreslɛm.

reference: Yehoiada maa Yoas ɔyerenom baanu a ɔne wɔn wowoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
hypothesis: Hɔɔd amayewas ɔyere no baanu a ɔne wɔn wowu mma mmarima ne mma mmaa.

reference: Na Misraimhene no tuu no adeɛ so Yerusalem, na ɔgyee asase no apeatoɔ dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne sika dwetikɛseɛ.
hypothesis: Mmesiamhwɛn no tuu no adeɛ so yɛresalam na ɔgye asaase a apeato dwetɛtɛ kɛseɛ ɔha ne sika dwetɛtɛ kɛseɛ.

reference: Nanso, na Awurade mpɛ sɛ ɔsɛe Dawid ahennie nnidisoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ, na ɔne Dawid ayɛ apam ahyɛ bɔ sɛ, nʼasefoɔ bɛkɔ so adi ɔhene afebɔɔ.
hypothesis: Nnanso na awuade mpɛ sɛ ɔsɛ dawid aheniiɛ didisuo afiri sɛ, na ɔne dawid ayɛ apam ahyɛbɔ sɛ, na ase foɔ bɛkɔ nso di hwene afebɔ.

reference: Na Sebulon antu Kitronfoɔ ne Nahalolfoɔ; na Kanaanfoɔ no tenaa wɔn mu, na wɔmaa wɔde ɔsom adwuma yii toɔ.
hypothesis: Asɛbrantu keturumfoɔ ne n'ahalɔfoɔ. Na kɛnamfoɔ no tena wɔn mu. Na ɔma ɔde ɔsom adwuma yi toɔ.

reference: Na AWURADE tiee Hesekia, na ɔsaa ɔman no yadeɛ.
hypothesis: Nawuradetie edzekia, na ɔsɛ ɔmaa no yɛ adeɛ.

reference: Na ne ba Yotam dii ɔhene fie no so, na ɔbuu asase no so man no atɛn.
hypothesis: Nnipa yi tam deɛ ɔhene fie no so. Na ɔbu asase no so ɔman no atɛn.

reference: Na wɔamfiri ɔhene mmara asɛm a ɛda asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no soɔ no ho, nsɛm nyinaa ne akoradeɛ no fam.
hypothesis: Wɔafiri ɔhene mmerɛnsɛm a asɔfoɔ ne ladifoɔ no so wɔ ne ho nsam nyinaa ne akwadaa ne fam.

reference: Onipa tenenee adesrɛ a emu yɛ den tumi yɛ nnoɔma bebree.
hypothesis: Nnipa tenene ade sradeɛ a emu yɛ den tumii yɛ nnoɔma bebree.

reference: Na ɔman no nyinaa, Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu mpanimfoɔ no, bɛgyinaa Nyankopɔn man dwabɔ no mu, wɔyɛ mmarima mpemahanan a wɔnam anammɔn mu a wɔtwe nkrantɛ.
hypothesis: Ɔman no nyinaa, ɛsraa amusuakuo nyinaa mu mpanimfoɔ no, bɛgyina nyankopɔnman dwabɔ no mu. Wɔyɛ mmarima mpemmaa hɛn nan a wɔnam anamɔmoa a wɔtwe nkranteɛ.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Lewifoɔ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ Israel nyinaa nhunumu na wɔyɛ akronkronfoɔ ma AWURADE no sɛ: Momfa adaka kronkron no mmɛsi efie a Israelhene Salomo, Dawid ba, siiɛ no mu.
hypothesis: Nɔka kyerɛ n'awifoɔ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ edwuraen nyinaa ahunu mu na wɔyɛ akronkronfoɔ ma awuraade no sɛ. Mmɔmfra adaka kɔnkron no mbesi efie a edwuraen no sɛlɛm derridi ba si yi mu.

reference: Na Samson ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wɔde nhomamono nson a ɛnwoeɛ kyekyere me a, ɛnneɛ mɛhodwo, na mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.
hypothesis: Asamhyɛn kakra no sɛ sɛ wɔde nhoma mono so a ɛno yɛ kyekyere mea ɛne mma wɔdwo na maya sɛ wɔn nipa biara.

reference: Yɛde nnareka to ɔpɔnkɔ anom sɛdeɛ ɔbɛtie yɛn na yɛatumi ama wakɔ baabiara a yɛpɛ sɛ ɔkɔ.
hypothesis: Yɛde nnare kato apɔnkɔ anum sɛdeɛ ɔbetie yɛn, na yatumi ama wɔkɔ baabi a yɛpɛ sɛ wɔkɔ.

reference: Na wɔwiee Seirfoɔ no, wɔboaa wɔn ho wɔn ho kunkumm wɔn ho wɔn ho.
hypothesis: Obi a esiafoɔ no, wɔaboa wɔn ho aho kunkum wɔn ho wɔn ho.

reference: Kerubim yi ntaban a wɔatrɛ mu no yɛ basafa du, na wɔgyinagyina wɔn nan so, na wɔn anim hwɛ ɛdan no.
hypothesis: Karibumie ntaban a watra mu no yɛ basafadu, na wɔgyinagyina wɔn nan so, na wɔn anim hwɛ dan no.

reference: Na ogyaframa no resɔre afiri afɔrebukyia no so akɔ soro no, AWURADE bɔfoɔ no foro faa afɔrebukyia no so gyaframa no mu kɔɔ soro.
hypothesis: Nawgyaframa no so de afiri bukyia no so akɔ soro no. Awadzebɔfoɔ no forofoɔ bukyia no so gyaframa no mu kɔ soro.

reference: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Gasafoɔ no sɛ: Samson aba ha, na wɔtwaa ne ho hyiae, na wɔtɛɛ no anadwo no kuro no pono ano, na wɔtaree dinn anadwo no nyinaa kaa sɛ: Adeɛ kye anɔpa a, yɛbɛku no.
hypothesis: Ɔkɔ kakraɛ kasafoɔ no sɛ samsey aba ha na ɔtwa ne ho hyiae na ɔtɛ no anadwo no kuro no pono ano. Na ɔtare di anadwo no nyinaa kaasɛ adeɛ ɛkyea nɔpa a yɛbɛku no.

reference: Ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ frɛɛ Awurade, maa ɔsaa no yadeɛ daa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nwanwasoɔ bi adi kyerɛɛ no.
hypothesis: Ɔbɔ mpaeɛ firi rade ma ɔsan yadeɛ dan sɛnkyerɛne wɔn wasoɔ bi redi kyerɛ no.

reference: Mika buaa sɛ, “Wobisa sɛ ɛdeɛn na worehwehwɛ a na wokyerɛ sɛn?
hypothesis: Mickerbow a sɛ wɔresase adeɛ na wɔrehwehwɛ a na wɔrekyerɛ sɛn.

reference: Ne Elisafan mma mu, Simri ne Yeiel; ne Asaf mma mu, Sakaria ne Matania; ne Heman mma mu: Yehiel ne Simei; ne Yedutun mma mu: Semaia ne Usiel.
hypothesis: Ni ɛli safan mma mu, simre ne yɛl ne asafo mma mu, sakari ne matanea, ne hema mma mu, yehɛl ne simɛl ne yɛdutu mma mu, sima ne yɛl.

reference: Nʼanimuonyam hyetaeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade boaa no yie kɔsii sɛ ɔnyaa tumi kɛseɛ.
hypothesis: N'anim ndzɛm hyɛ tae efiri sɛ dadeboa no yie kɔsi hyɛ ndzɛm tumi kɛseɛ.

reference: Anaasɛ mosusu sɛ atwerɛ no kasa kwa, sɛ: Ɔtwe ne honhom a ɔte yɛn mu no ho ninkunu?
hypothesis: Anaasɛ mu susu sɛ atwerɛfoɔ no kasapa sɛ ɔtwe ne ho ho a ɔte yɛ mu no ho ne nkunom.

reference: Na ne na din de Yehoadan a ɔfiri Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Maame n'aden de yɛho adan a ofiri yɛresalam.

reference: Na da a ɛtɔ so nson no ɔka kyerɛɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔha no.
hypothesis: Nnadaa a ɛtɔ so nson no, wɔaka kyerɛ no, efiri sɛ na ɔha no.

reference: Sɛ motumi kyerɛ me aseɛ nnanson apontoɔ yi mu na mohunu a, ɛnneɛ mɛma mo nkamisaa aduasa ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho aduasa; na sɛ moantumi ankyerɛ me a, mo nso momma me nkamisaa aduasa ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho aduasa.
hypothesis: Sɛmɔtumi kyerɛmɛ aseɛ n'aso apom toa yi mu na wɔn mu no a ɛne mmɛma mɔ nkaamisa aduasa ne ntaadeɛ nsa kyerɛ ho aduasa. Na sɛmɔtumi a nkyerɛmɛ a wɔn nso wɔn maame nkaamisa aduasa ne ntaadeɛ nsa kyerɛ ho aduasa.

reference: Na AWURADE abufuo dɛre tiaa Israel, na ɔtɔnee wɔn hyɛɛ Filistifoɔ ne Amonfoɔ nsa.

reference: Mpaeɛ biara a wɔbɛbɔ wɔ ha no, mɛtie, ɛfiri sɛ, mayi saa Asɔredan yi asi hɔ sɛ me fie daa daa.
hypothesis: Mpaayewa biara a wɔbɛbɔ wɔ ha no, metie afiri sɛ, mbɛyisa a sɔredan si hɔ sɛ ne fie daadaa.

reference: Na Barak ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wo ne me bɛkɔ a, ɛnneɛ mɛkɔ; na sɛ wo ne me renkɔ a, ɛnneɛ merenkɔ.
hypothesis: Naba a wɔaka kyerɛ no sɛ sɛ ɔne mmɛko a ɛne ɛma kɔ. Na sɛ ɔne mmɛnkɔ a ɛne mmɛnkɔ.

reference: Na Amonfoɔ no maa no dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne ayuo kor mpemdu ne atokoɔ nso mpemdu afe no mu.
hypothesis: Amanfoɔ no ma no, gyita gyate kɛseɛ ɔha ne ayuro kɔɔl, mpimdu ne atokuo nso mpimdu afe no mu.

reference: Na wɔde ogya totoo Twam dwan no sɛdeɛ amammerɛ teɛ.

reference: Ɛnna Israel mma no su frɛɛ AWURADE, na AWURADE maa ɔgyefoɔ bi so maa wɔn, Gera ba Ehud, Benyaminni a ɔyɛ abenkumma no.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɛdzi lae mma no so frɛ ɛwɔ ade. Na ɛwɔ ade ma ɔgyefoɔ bi so maa. Gɛlaba ehu. Bɛl ma ani a ɔyɛ abankumaa no.

reference: Na Yehoiakim ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne n’akyiwadeɛ a ɔyɛeɛ, ne deɛ wɔhunuu no ne ho no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Israel ne Yuda Ahemfo Nwoma no mu.

reference: Ɛno na Salomo kɔɔ Esion-geber ne Elot mpoano wɔ Edom asase so.
hypothesis: Anonner Salamon call esuon gyeaba ne ɛlɔt mpoano wɔ ɛdɔm asaase so.

reference: Ɔne wʼadwumfoɔ ne wɔn a me wura Dawid a ɔyɛ wʼagya no yii wɔn no bɛyɛ adwuma.
hypothesis: Ɔne wɔadwumayɛfoɔ ne wɔn a mewura dawid a ɔyɛ mɛgya no yie wɔn no so bɛyɛ adwuma.

reference: Na ɔbaa no yɛɛ ntɛm tutuu mmirika kɔka kyerɛɛ ne kunu sɛ: Hwɛ, ɔbarima a ɔbaa me nkyɛn nnaano no abɛyi ne ho adi akyerɛ me.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa no yɛ ntam tutu mirika kɔ kakra ne kunu sɛ hwɛ. Ɔbarima a ɔbaa no nkyɛn n'ano no abɛyi ne ho akyerɛ me.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no kɔɔ so yɛɛ deɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne; nso na Ehud awu.
hypothesis: Asraafoɔ no kɔɔ so yɛdeɛ ɛwura adeɛ ne so bɔneɛ. Nsona ahu dawu.

reference: Wɔfifiri akyirikyiri te sɛ Lebo Hamat a ɛwɔ atifi fam kɔsi Misraim asuwa anafoɔ fam no.
hypothesis: Wɔfirfir akyirikyi te sɛ label hammer a ɛwɔ ɛtefiri fam kɔsi me dwum asi hɔ anaa afɔ fam no.

reference: Na ɔne no pam sɛ wɔbɛyeyɛ ahyɛn akɔ Tarsis, na wɔpempam ahyɛn no Esion-geber.
hypothesis: Ɔne no pam sɛ ɔbaa yi yɛ ahyɛn akɔtaases. Na ɔpempam ahyɛn no esiɛn gyeeda.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Odidifoɔ mu na aduane firi baeɛ.
hypothesis: Ɔka kyerɛ wɔn nsa ɔdi difuom na aduane firi bae.

reference: Afei, asɔfoɔ no kunkumm mpapo no sɛ bɔne ho afɔrebɔ, de wɔn mogya petee afɔrebukyia no so, sɛ bɔne ho mpatadeɛ maa Israel nyinaa.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ no kunkumpapono sɛbɔ ne ho afɔrebɔ de wɔn mogya petee a wɔrebukyia no so sɛbɔ ne ho mpa ataadeɛ ma eyuraw nyinaa.

reference: Na Israel hene no sakyeraa ne ho, na ɔkɔɔ dɔm no mu.
hypothesis: N'edzerɛ ahen no sakyerɛ a ne ho. Nɔkɔɔdɔm no mu.

reference: Na Yosia dii Twam Afahyɛ no wɔ Yerusalem maa AWURADE, na wɔkumm Twam dwan no bosome a ɛdi kan no, da a ɛtɔ so dunan no so.
hypothesis: Yɛɛ osiadeɛ twam afahyɛ no wɔ yɛlo sɛlɛma awuade. Na wokum twam dwa no bosum yɛ edi kan no. Dɛɛtɔso du nnan no so.

reference: Adekyeɛ mu no, nnipa no tuaa nhema sii afɔrebukyia, na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ.
hypothesis: Adetwea mu no, nnipa no tuo a nneɛma hyɛ afare bukyia, na ɔbɔ ɔhyia ne asomdua afadeɛ.

reference: Ɔhene Ahas wuiɛ no, wɔsiee no wɔ Yerusalem, nanso wɔansie no wɔ adehyeɛ amusieeɛ.
hypothesis: Ɔhene a so wɔreyɛ no, wɔsua yi no wɔ Yurisilin, nanso wɔn nsia no wɔ adehyia mu sieɛ.

reference: Na ɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ no kɔmaa Moabhene Eglon; nso na Eglon yɛ onipa brane pa ara.
hypothesis: Nnɔdeayɛ adeɛ no kɔmmɔ a mmɔwene agorɔn. Nsonan agorɔn yi onipa braani paa.

reference: Na yɛn mu biara bɛma wo nnwetɛbena kilogram dumienu ne fa.
hypothesis: Mmaa biara abɛma wɔ dwetabena kylogran do mmienu ne fɛm.

reference: Ɛnna Israel hene no boaboaa adiyifoɔ no ano hyiaeɛ, nnipa ahanan, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Yɛnkɔ Ramot-gilead nkɔko, anaasɛ mennyae?
hypothesis: Ɛna edzra a ɛhene bo abɔ adifo ano hyiaeɛ. Nnipa ahanan. Na wɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛe, yɛnkɔ round round gilliad nkɔkɔɔ, anaa sɛe mi nyiaeɛ.

reference: Na Usia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn ahemfo asieeɛ asase no so, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɔyaree kwata.
hypothesis: Nsia te ne gya no wɔ asa mmaa do. Na wɔsia ne gya no mu nkyɛn ahenfoɔ esia yɛ asaase no so. Na wɔka asɛ ɔyere kwata.

reference: Na wɔde ntampehoma foforɔ mmienu kyekyeree no, na wɔde no foro firii ɔbotan no mu.
hypothesis: Nna wɔde ntampen nhoma foforɔ mmienu tete no. Na wɔde no frufiri ɔbotan no mu.

reference: Filistifoɔ aba sɛ wɔrebɛkye wo!
hypothesis: Folisifoɔ no aba rebɛkyɛw. Na nso ɔtete egya nhoma so a ɛnwie no mu te sɛ .

reference: Na asɔfoɔ no kunkumm wɔn, na wɔde wɔn mogya no yɛɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ guu afɔrebukyia no ho sɛ wɔde repata ama Israel nyinaa.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ no konkumu, na wɔde wɔn  wɔn gya no yɛ ɛbɔne ho afadeɛ agu afɔn bukyi a ne ho sɛ wɔde repata ama Israel nyinaa.

reference: Na ɔbarima yi deɛ, monnyɛ no nkwaseadeɛ a ɛte sɛɛ.
hypothesis: Ɔbarima yi deɛ, wɔn nyɛ no nkwasiadeɛ a ɛte saa.

reference: Nanso ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ho sradeɛ ne ahwiesa a ɛka ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho dɔɔso bebree.
hypothesis: Nantseɛfoɔ deɛ ne asomduafoɔ deɛ ho sradeɛ ne ɛhwiesa a ɛka ɔhyiafoɔ deɛ no ho dɔɔso bebree.

reference: Sika a wɔgyegyee no Awurade Asɔredan no mu no, wɔde ama sohwɛfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ no.
hypothesis: Sika a wɔgyegye no awuadeɛ asɔe dan no mu no, wɔde ama sohwɛfoɔ ne adwumayɛfoɔ no.

reference: Na yei kɔɔ so ara kɔsii sɛ, mfeɛ mmienu awieeɛ no, n’ayamdeɛ firii adie yadeɛ no ara mu, na ɔwuu yea kɛseɛ mu.
hypothesis: Yei kɔ soro akɔsie sɛ mfie mmienu ɛwieyɛ no. Na yamdeɛ ɛfiri ɛdeɛ yɛdeɛ no ara mu. Na wuiiara kɛseɛ mu.

reference: Ɛwom, saa asɔredan yi yɛ fɛ deɛ, nanso ɛbɛyɛ atantanneɛ ama wɔn a wɔtwa mu hɔ no.
hypothesis: Wɔ mu, saa asɔredan yɛ fɛdeɛ, nanso ɛbɛyɛ atantaneɛ ama wɔn a wɔtwa mu hɔ no.

reference: Na Samson siane kɔɔ Timna, na ɔkɔhunuu ɔbaa bi wɔ Timna a ɔyɛ Filistifoɔ mmammaa no bi.
hypothesis: Asam sensane kɔ timna na wɔkɔ hunu ɔbaa bi wɔ timna a ɔyɛ afilisifoɔ mma mmaa no bi.

reference: Na wɔsiane dii n’akyi, na wɔkɔfaa Yordan atwareeɛ a wɔde kɔ Moab no, na wɔamma obiara antwa.
hypothesis: Nɛɛ osane di n'akyi. Na ɔkɔfo a yɛɛdan atware a wɔde kɔmmo abo no. Na wama obiara ntwɛn.

reference: Na afei, mo adefoɔ e, mo amanehunu a ɛreba mo soɔ nti, monsu na mommɔ bena!
hypothesis: Aha yi, mmoa de fui, mmoa ma ne hunu a ɛreba mu soɔ ti. Emu nsu na ɔmɔ bina.

reference: Na ɔsane sii Awurade afɔrebukyia no, bɔɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aseda afɔdeɛ wɔ so.
hypothesis: Ɔsan si rade afɔ rebɔ kyia no bɔ asomwia afɔdeɛ ne aseda afɔdeɛ wɔ so.

reference: Sɛ Israelfoɔ di mʼahyɛdeɛ nyinaa so, me mmara a wɔnam Mose so maeɛ no nyinaa so a, merentwa wɔn asuo mfiri asase a mede maa wɔn agyanom no so.
hypothesis: Sɛ edwafoɔ edi ma hyɛde nyinaa so, mmɛmbra a wɔnam mɔɔsi so maeɛ no nyinaa so a, mmɛntwa wɔn asuo mfiri asase a mmɛdeɛmaa wɔn egya no mu no so.

reference: Ɛnna Hilkia ne wɔn a ɔhene somaa wɔn no kɔɔ Odiyifoɔbaa Hulda a ɔyɛ Hasra ba Tikwat ba Salum ntadehwɛfoɔ yere no nkyɛn.

reference: Na AWURADE honhom sii ne so, na ntampehoma a ɛwɔ ne basa ho no yɛɛ sɛ asaawa a wɔde ogya aka na ne homa no sanesane firii ne nsa.
hypothesis: Nɛɛde wohum si ne so. Na ntaapɛn nhoma a ɛwɔ ne basaho no yɛ sɛ asaawa a ɔde egya aka. Na ne nhoma no sane sane firi ne nsa.

reference: Sikakɔkɔɔ amapa bɛyɛ nkariboɔ tɔno aduonu mmiɛnsa na wɔde guu so.
hypothesis: Sikakɔkɔɔ ama papa bɛyɛ nkari bɔtɔɔ no. eduonu mmiɛnsa na wɔde gu so.

reference: Wɔmaa Yoas Onyankopɔn mmara nwoma no bi daa no adi sɛ ɔhene.
hypothesis: Wɔ mmaayewa s ɔnye akopɔ mberɛn a nwoma no bi da no, ɛdi sɛ ɔhene.

reference: Ɛnna asomafoɔ no sene firii kuro mu kɔɔ kuro mu, Efraim ne Manase asase so de kɔsii Sebulon tɔnn.
hypothesis: Ɛna asomafoɔ no sini firi kuro no mu kɔ kuro mu. Efiri anim anaa ase asaase so de kɔsi sɛ blɔntɔn.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mete sɛ wo, na me man te sɛ wo man, me ne wo bɛkɔ ɔsa no.
hypothesis: Ɔkaakyerɛ no sɛ, me te sɛ ɛwo na wɔn man te sɛ meman. Me no rebɛkɔ ɔsa no.

reference: Na Yehosafat ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, akane deɛ ne akyire yi deɛ no, hwɛ, wɔatwerɛ no Hanani ba Yehu nsɛm a wɔde hyɛɛ Israel ahemfo nwoma mu no mu.
hypothesis: Aha yɛn ho safa ato nsam nkaeɛ. Akanee deɛ ne akyerɛ deɛ no hwɛ. Wɔatwerɛ no hanan ne ba yehu nsam a wɔde hyɛ edurayɛnfo nwoma no mu no.

reference: Na Manoa bɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ sɛ: O AWURADE, ma Nyankopɔn nipa a wosomaa no no mmra yɛn nkyɛn bio, na ɔmmɛkyerɛ yɛn deɛ yɛnyɛ abɔfra a wɔrebɛwo no no.
hypothesis: Namano abɔ awuradie mpaeɛ sɛ ɔwuradie. Manyinakopɔ nnipa a osumano no, mmerɛ yɛn nkyɛn biw, na wɔn akyerɛ yɛn deɛ, yɛn anya abɔfra a ɔbɛ wɔ no no.

reference: Ɛnna Yefta ne Gilead mpanimfoɔ no sii mu baeɛ, na ɔman no de no sii wɔn ti ne ɔsafohene.
hypothesis: Ɛna yɛfita ne gilɛɛde mpanimfoɔ no si mbaeɛ. Na ɔman no de no si wɔn ti ne ɔsafo hwene.

reference: Na Amorifoɔ no tumi tenaa Heres bepɔ so wɔ Ayalon ne Saalbim, nanso Yosef fie nsa yɛɛ wɔn so den, na wɔde ɔsom adwuma yii toɔ.
hypothesis: Amaayewa no tumi tsena a helis bepɔ so wɔ ayaarɔne saa bi mu. Na asodwɔs efie nsa yɛ wɔn so den. Na wɔde ɔsom adwuma yi toɔ.

reference: Yosia ahennie ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne nʼahofama sɛdeɛ Awurade mmara teɛ no, firi ahyɛaseɛ kɔsi awieeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ agu Israel ne Yuda Ahemfo Nwoma mu.
hypothesis: Yɛɛdzi a aheniiɛ ho nsam nkaeɛ ne n'ahofam asɛ de ɛwɔ ade mmerateɛ no firi ahyɛsɛ kɔsi ewieɛ no, wɔatwerɛ gu edwa no yuta ahenfo nwoma mu.

reference: Afei Israelfoɔ su frɛɛ Awurade sɛ, “Yɛayɛ bɔne atia wo, ɛfiri sɛ yɛatwe yɛn ho afiri yɛn Onyankopɔn ho na yɛasom Baal ahoni.
hypothesis: Afee, adwurafoɔ so firi radesɛ. Yɛayɛbɔ no atua ho. Efi sɛ yɛatwe ho efie nyanko pɔn ho de asom baal a honi.

reference: Saa fie yi mu nnipa kɔɔ so yɛɛ asɔfoɔ maa Dan abusuakuo kɔsii Otukorɔ berɛ.
hypothesis: Asrafie yi mu nnipa kɔ so yɛ asɔfoɔ ma dan abusua kuo kɔ so yi, otu kɔberee.

hypothesis: Ekukuo, nsofi, ɛnam narewa ne nneɛma a ɛkeka ho nyinaa.

reference: Afei, Nun babarima Yosua, Awurade ɔsomfoɔ wuiɛ a na wadi mfirinhyia ɔha ne edu.
hypothesis: Yosua a wohunu nneɛma kɛseɛ a wɔde yɛma adwira yosua nkɔ nan nyinaa mu no, afei, no nnua barima yosua, wɔde sumfoɔ wie a na wɔde mfiri hyɛ ɔha no yɛ du.

reference: Na wɔntena ɔhene no ho n’adifire ne ne muba mu.
hypothesis: Wɔtena ɔhene no ho, na difire ne ne mu ba mu.

reference: Ɔyɛɛ dwaresɛn edu a wɔkora nsuo a wɔde hohoro afɔrebɔdeɛ ho.

reference: Na Bet-semesfoɔ ne Bet-anatfoɔ no de ɔsom adwuma yii wɔn toɔ.
hypothesis: Bɛɛsemasfoɔ ne bɛt anatfoɔ no de ɔsom adwuma yi wɔn toɔ.

reference: Anammɔn baako biara mu no, na anantwie sɛso nsia wɔ so a wɔagu ama afra nsukoradeɛ no.
hypothesis: Anamɔn baako biara mu no, na anantwie sɛ so nsia wɔ so a wogu ama afra sopradeɛ no.

reference: Na Yosia yii nnwan nnwanten mma ne mmirekyie mma maa ɔman mma no, sɛ wɔmfa ne nyinaa nyeyɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa Twam afɔdeɛ, wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpemaduasa ne anantwie nso mpensa.
hypothesis: Ayaresua yi nnwan nnwantene mma ne nnwura kyerɛ mma ma ɔman mma no sɛ wɔn fa no nyinaa nyeyɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa atwam afadeɛ. Wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpemadua sa ne anantwie nso mpem saa.

reference: Ɔde awɛmfoɔ no twaa ɔhene no ho hyiaeɛ a wɔayɛ wɔn akodeɛ krado.
hypothesis: Wɔde ahwemfoɔ no twa ɔhene no ho hyiae a wɔyɛ wɔn akodeɛ krado.

reference: Monnsuro Asiriahene anaa nʼakodɔm kɛseɛ no, na yɛwɔ tumi a ɛso wɔ yɛn afa.
hypothesis: Musuru asɔre ahen ananakodɔm kɛseɛ no, na awutumi a ɛso wɔyɛ afa.

reference: Na akodɔm no dodoɔ yɛ ɔpehasa ne nson ne ahanum a wɔn nyinaa nim de.

reference: Na Yuda kɔfaa Gasa ne ne hyeɛ ne Askelon ne ne hyeɛ ne Ekron ne ne hyeɛ.
hypothesis: Wi da nkurɔfoɔ a gasane no ahyia, ne askeleɔ no ahyia, ne koroɔne no ahyia.

reference: Woyɛ no yie; ahonhommɔne nso gye di, na wɔn ho popo.

reference: Na wɔkyɛɛ nneɛma no maa asɔfoɔ a wɔatwerɛ wɔn din wɔ wɔn abusuadua nwoma mu ne Lewifoɔ a wɔadi mfeɛ aduonu ne deɛ ɛboro saa, a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn din sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma ne wɔn nkyekyɛmu teɛ.
hypothesis: Nneɛma no ma asɔfo a wɔatwerɛ wɔn din wɔn wɔn abusua dua nhoma no mu. Ne laenfoɔ a wɔadi mfie dua no ne deɛ ɛboro saa a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn din sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma ne wɔn kyikyɛmɔteɛ.

reference: Na da a ɛtɔ so nnan no, wɔboaboaa wɔn ano wɔ Beraka Bonhwa no mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɛhɔ na wɔhyiraa AWURADE, enti na wɔfrɛ ɛhɔ din sɛ “Beraka-Bonhwa” de bɛsi nnɛ.

reference: Na Yehoram dii n’agya adeɛ na n’ahennie gyinaa pintinn no, ɔde nkrantɛ kunkumm ne nuammarimanom nyinaa ne Israel mmapɔmma mu binom nso.

hypothesis: Nsɛm ne nnwuma mu na kura adie yi akyiri no, ase reahene sanahɛrebae, na ɔbae yi da so bɛkyiri nkuro a ɛyɛ den no ho nsraban, na osu sɛ ɔbedwiri afa.

reference: Na ɔno so na Sikri ba Amasia a ɔde ne ho maa AWURADE som kwa no die, na mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho mpemahanu ka ne ho.
hypothesis: Ɔno nso na asi kuruba amasia a ɔde ne ho ma awuraade so mu kwan no di. Na mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho, mpem aheɛ no ka ne ho.

reference: Na Salomo wiee AWURADE fie ne ɔhene fie no.
hypothesis: Salamonwie, awurade fie ne ɔhene fie no.

reference: Wɔfirii Efraim a wɔn nhini muni dii Amalek soɔ.
hypothesis: Wɔfiri afiri ma wɔn hwene mu no dii amelɛks wɔn.

reference: Afei, nso, nneɛma a ɔhene Ahas tasee wɔ ɛberɛ a na ɔyɛ asoɔden, na ɔtoo asɔredan no mu no nso, yɛakɔgye ne nyinaa.
hypothesis: Afei nso, nneɛma a ɔhene ha stase wɔ berɛ anan na ɔyɛ asoɔden na ɔto asɔredan no mu so no. Wɔakɔgye no nyinaa.

reference: Wɔn nyinaa ani gyeeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, na Awurade ne Dawid, Salomo ne nkurɔfoɔ Israelfoɔ adi no yie.
hypothesis: Wɔn nyinaa ani gyeɛfiri sɛ na awuade no dawiri. Salon ne nkurɔfoɔ adwirafoɔ no adi no yie.

reference: Na ɔde sika kataa ɛdan no mpuna, aponnwa, n’afasuo ne n’apono ntanta no ho.
hypothesis: Wɔde sika kata ɛdan no mu pono, akonwa, n'afasuo ne n'apono ntaataa no ho.

reference: Enti, anuanom, monya abodwokyɛre nkɔduru da a Awurade bɛba.
hypothesis: Ntiannua no mu, munya abɔ dwutere, nkɔduru da a awuraade bɛba.

reference: Nnipa a wɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ mo mfuo mu no, montuaa wɔn ka enti wɔresi apinie.
hypothesis: Nnipa a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mu mfiri mu no, wɔntua wɔn nka, nti wɔresua pinin.

reference: Ne berɛ so na Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa aseɛ, na wɔkɔsii wɔn so hene.
hypothesis: Nnipa nso na edɔm te atua afiri yi da nsa aseɛ. Na wɔkɔsi wɔn so hene.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Gyina ntomadan no pono ano, na sɛ obi ba na ɔbisa wo sɛ obi wɔ hɔ anaa a, woaka akyerɛ no sɛ: Dabi.
hypothesis: Ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ gyina ntomadan no pono ano. Na sɛ obi bɛna obi saa obi wɔ hɔ anaa waka kyerɛ no sɛ dan bi.

reference: Anuanom, monngugu ahome nntiatia mo ho, na wɔammu mo atɛn.
hypothesis: Anuanom, mu ngugu ahome ntiatia mu ho, na wɔn mu mu atɛn.

reference: Na Yefta hyɛɛ AWURADE bɔ sɛ: Sɛ wode Amonfoɔ no hyɛ me nsa a, ɛnneɛ deɛ ɛbɛfiri me fie apono ano abɛhyia me da a meresane mafiri Amonfoɔ so dwoodwoo no, ɛbɛyɛ AWURADE deɛ, na mede bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ mu.
hypothesis: Ayaftahyɛ awuradebɔ sɛ sɛ wɔde a amɔfoɔ no hyɛ ne nsa a ɛna yɛdeɛ ɛbɛfiri mfia pono ano abɛhyia me dɛ mɛɛsan bɛfiri a amɔfoɔ so yɛɛdwo no. Ɛbɛyɛ awuradeɛ, na mmɛdebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ mu.

reference: Ɛberɛ biara a Israelfoɔ bɛkɔ ɔko no, Awurade ko tia wɔn ma wɔdi nkoguo, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ bɔ no.
hypothesis: Abusuakuo no mu biara akɔ fa ne gyapadeɛ a wɔde mmaa no sɛ ne kyɛ fa no. Na adwira foɔ no so ade wɔ yosua ne mpanimfoɔ a wɔnye ne se ne yosua a wohunu nneɛma akɛseɛ a wɔde yɛ ma adwira yosua nkɔn no nyinaa mu no.

reference: Na Manoa ka kyerɛɛ ne yere sɛ: Wuo na yɛrebɛwuwuo, sɛ yɛahunu Onyankopɔn yi.
hypothesis: Namanoa aka kyerɛ ne yere sɛ wɔn a ɛbɛwowu te ahunu nyanko pɔn yi.

reference: Aboɔdemmoɔ a ɛyɛ fɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a ɛfiri Parwaim na wɔde siesiee Asɔredan no afasuo ho.
hypothesis: Aborɔdemoɔ a ɛyɛ fɛ ne sika kɔkɔɔ a ɛfiri paawem, na wɔde siesie asɔredan no afasuo ho.

reference: Ahonhommɔne nso gye di saa ara na wɔn ho popo wɔ suro mu.
hypothesis: Ahombɔne nso gyidi saa ara na wɔn ho pepo wɔ soro mu.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no nso firii hɔ berɛ no mu kɔɔ wɔn mmusuakuo ne wɔn mmusua mu, na wɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ wɔn agyapadeɛ ho.
hypothesis: Asraafoɔ no nso firi hɔ. Bɛɛ no mu kɔ wɔn mmusua kuo ne wɔn mmusua mu. Na wɔfiri hɔ kɔ wɔn agyapadeɛ ho.

reference: Ɔwɔ akuafoɔ ne bobeturoyɛfoɔ, mmepɔ so ne Karmel so, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔpɛ kua.
hypothesis: Ɔwɔ akuafoɔ ne bobaturo yɛfoɔ, mmepɔ so ne kaa man so. Efirisɛn na ɔpɛkua.

reference: Ɛnyɛ ɔko a ɔne Filistifoɔ koeɛ no mu nko ara na Onyankopɔn boaa no, na mmom ɔko a ɔne Arabfoɔ a wɔwɔ Gur Baal koeɛ ne Meunifoɔ ko mu nso, ɔboaa no.
hypothesis: Ɛnye ɔko a n'afelisfoɔ kɔyɛ no mu anko na ɔnya kor pɔmboa no. N'emom ɔko a ɔne arafoɔ a ɔwɔ guilbae kooyɛ ne mmienu foɔ kɔn mu nso, ɔboa no.

reference: Afei, da bi anadwo, Awurade yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Salomo, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ.
hypothesis: Afee, dɛbia n'adwo. Waade yi ne ho adi kyerɛ sɛlɛmɔ, na ɔka kyɛ no sɛm.

reference: Ɔworɔɔ nʼahentadeɛ no guu nkyɛn baabi sɛdeɛ atamfoɔ no renhunu no.
hypothesis: Wɔwrɔ na ahyɛtadeɛ no gu nkyɛn baabi sɛdeɛ atamfoɔ no reho no.

reference: Israelfoɔ no bisaa deɛ ɛyɛeɛ a saa awudisɛm yi siiɛ.
hypothesis: Adwadifoɔ no bi hyɛ adeɛ ɛyɛ a saa ɛwɔdi sɛm sii.

reference: Na kerub baako no nso ataban yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, na ɛka ɛdan no fasuo no, na ataban baako no nso yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, na ɛpem kerub baako no ataban no.
hypothesis: Karubu baako no nso ataban yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa. Na ka adan no fasuo no, na ataban baako no nso yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa. Na ɛpim karubu baako no ataban no.

reference: Na Amasia firii Edomfoɔ kum sane baeɛ no, ɔde Seirfoɔ anyame bae, na ɔde bɛsisii hɔ fae sɛ anyame, na ɔkotoo wɔn anim, na ɔhyee aduhwam maa wɔn.
hypothesis: Abaasia firi edɔm foɔ kum san baeɛ no. Ɔde siefoɔ ɛnyame baaeɛ na ɔde besisi hɔ fae sɛ ɛnyame. Na ɔkɔtow wɔn anim na ɔhyɛ aduhwɛmaa wɔn.

reference: Na ɔman no nyinaa sɔre gyinaa sɛ ɔbarima baako kaa sɛ: Yɛn mu biara renkɔ ntomadan mu, na yɛn mu biara remmane ne fie.
hypothesis: Ɔman no nyinaa asɔre gyina asɛ ɔbarima baako ka asɛ. Wɔn mu biara nkɔntomadan mu. Na wɔn mu biara amane ne fie.

reference: Na Hesekia kaa sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia no so.
hypothesis: Mmaadakia aka asɛ wɔn a ɔhyiafoɔ deɛ afɔrobukyia no so.

reference: Na sɛ mowɔ nitanmmɔne ne mansotwe mo akoma mu a, ɛnneɛ monnhoahoa mo ho, na monnni atorɔ nntia nokorɛ.
hypothesis: Asɛm ɛmu wɔ nitaa mmɔne ne manso twe mu akumamua ɛneɛ muhuahoam hɔn na mu ni atrɔ ntia nnɔprɛ.

reference: ” Ɛberɛ a ɔhene Eglon sɔre firii nʼakonnwa mu ara pɛ, Ehud de ne nsa benkum twee sekan a ɔde ahyɛ ne srɛ nifa ho no de wɔɔ ɔhene no yafunu mu.
hypothesis: Ɛbra ɔhene egu no, sɔre firi n'akonwa mu ara pɛ. Ewu de ne nsa benkum twerɛ sekan a ɔde hyɛ ne serɛ nifa no so no de wɔ ɔhene no yɛ funu mu.

reference: Na Sikri, Efraim dɔmmarima bi, kumm ɔhene ba Maaseia ne ahemfie bapɔmma Asrikam ne Elkana a ɔdi ɔhene akyire.
hypothesis: Nasekuri efiri dɔm barima bi kum ɔhene ba ma ase ne ahemfo bɔɔma asre kame ne ɛka naa odi ɔhene akyire.

reference: Mekaa sɛ, Meremmu mʼapam a me ne mo ayɛ no so.
hypothesis: Mbɛrima sɛ mbɛrima mu apam a mbɛnim ayɛ no so.

reference: Na Yehoiada waree yerenom baanu maa no, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
hypothesis: Ɛhɔ adaware renom baanu ɛmaa no na ɔwɔ ma mmarima ne mma mmaa.

reference: Ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa a aka no di Awurade mmara so, na wɔtenatena afikyire.
hypothesis: Nsensɛn nnipa a aka no redi adwadɛmira so na wɔtenatena afikyire.

reference: ’ Afei, Ao Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn, di saa bɔ a woahyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ Dawid no so.
hypothesis: Afei a ɔde adi adi anya nkopɔn. Ndesuabɔ a wahyɛ wɔsomfoɔ dawiri no so.

reference: Wɔn a wɔfiri Kohat abusua mu no ne: Amasai babarima Mahat ne Asaria babarima Yoɛl.
hypothesis: Wɔn a wɔfiri kohat abusua mu ne ama sae ba barima ma hat ne ase yɛ ba barima yiwa.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no de ayɛyɛdeɛ nam ne so kɔmaa Moabhene Eglon.
hypothesis: Asraafoɔ no deɛ yɛdeɛ nam ne so kɔmmɔ a mmɔabene aglɔn.

reference: Ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ, “Monkɔ no asomdwoeɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade bɛdi mo anim wɔ mo akwantuo no mu.
hypothesis: Ɔsɔfoɔ no krataa, moko na sundua mu afiri sɛ adeɛ bɛdi wɔn anim wɔ m'akwantuo no mu. Mmarima baanum no kɔ kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no laes mu.

reference: Na ahyɛn no bobɔe, na wɔantumi ankɔ Tarsis.
hypothesis: N'ahyɛn no bɔ bɔɔl na wɔntumi a nkɔta asɛs.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wode me tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntomaban nwono a.
hypothesis: Ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ sɛɛ ɔde ne tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntoma ban nwoma.

reference: Ɛberɛ a saa akofoɔ yi duruu Efraim bepɔ asase so no, wɔkɔɔ Mika fie kɔdaa hɔ anadwo no.
hypothesis: Ɛberee a saa akofoɔ yi duu efina bepɔ asase no so. Wɔkɔ mirika fie kɔda hɔ anadwen.

reference: Na ɔtotoo aban atentene nso ɛserɛ so, na ɔtutuu mmura pii, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔwɔ mmoakuo bebree mpaperɛ ne asaseta so.
hypothesis: Nnɔto aban tenten nso ɛsrɛ so. Na wɔtu mwura pii. Efirisɛn na wɔn moa kuo bebree, mpaprɛ no ne asaase ta so.

reference: Nanso, ɛrekɔ nʼasetena awieeɛ no, ɔhene Yehosafat ne Israelhene Ahasia a ne tirim yɛ den no kaa wɔn ho bɔɔ mu.
hypothesis: Naa so ɛrekɔ n'asesena ewieɛ no. Ɔhene yɛ osa fa ne edu ɔhene ahahyia ɛna ne kyiniiɛ de no ka wɔn ho bɔn mu.

reference: Afei, Ehud totoo apono no mu foroo agyanan dan no, faa ne nsuseneeɛ no mu dwane kɔeɛ.
hypothesis: Afee ɛwɔ totɔto apono no mu frɔ egyanan dan no fa ne nsu suneɛ no mu dwane kɔɔe.

reference: Na mfeɛ bi akyiri no, ɔsiane kɔɔ Ahab nkyɛn Samaria, na Ahab kunkumm nnwan ne anantwie bebree maa no ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho no.
hypothesis: Nantwie bi akyire no, osiane kɔ habɔ nkyɛn samɛɛre, ma hab kuntum nnwan ne anantwie bebree ma ano ne nkurɔfoɔ a ɔka ne ho no.

reference: Na Manoa sɔre dii ne yere no akyi na ɔbaa ɔbarima no nkyɛn, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wone ɔbarima a wo ne ɔbaa no kasaeɛ no?
hypothesis: Dɛmanoa so edi ne yere no ekyi na ɔbɔ ɔbarima no nkyɛn na ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ ɔne ɔbarima ɔne ɔbaa no kasaeɛ no.

reference: Ɛnna wɔkumm Twam Dwan no bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no.
hypothesis: Ɛna wɔkum twam dwa no, wɔsɔmia ɛtɔ so mmienu dɛɛ ɛtɔ so dunnan no.

reference: Baabi a ɔsii abosonsom asɔreeɛ, sisii Asera afɔrebukyia ne ahoni ansa na ɔrenu ne ho no nso ka ho.
hypothesis: Baabi a osi abosonan asɔreɛ sisi asraafoɔ rebukyia ne ahonin. Ansa na ɔrenu ne ho no nso ka ho.

reference: Amanaman yi a m’agyanom asɛe wɔn pasapasa no anyame nyinaa mu hwan na watumi agye ne man me nsam, na mo nyame na ɔbɛtumi agye mo me nsam?
hypothesis: Amaa mmaa yi a mbagya no asɛe wɔn pasapasa no anyaame nyinaa mu hɔn ena watumi agye ne maeɛ me nsam. Na mu nnyɛma yi na ɔbetumi agye mu me nsam.

reference: Na yeinom kɔhyɛnee Mika fie kɔfaa ohoni a wɔasene, asɔfotadeɛ ne abusua ahoni ne agudeɛ no no, ɔsɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na moreyɛ yi?
hypothesis: Yeinom kɔhyɛ ne mirika fie kɔ fa ohonin a wasene. Asɔfotadeɛ ne abusua honin ne agudeɛ no. Ɔsɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ, ɛdeɛ nam mu yie.

reference: AWURADE temmufoɔ no ɔmmu Israelfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ ntam atɛn nnɛ.
hypothesis: Awuradetamufoɔ no, wɔn mu sraene amɔmfoɔ ntam atɛn no.

reference: Na wɔkaa sɛ, “Adɛn enti na ɛsɛ sɛ Asiria ahemfo bɛba ha abɛnya nsuo bebree?
hypothesis: Wɔreka sɛ adɛnti na ɛsɛsɛ asɛwia ahenfo bɛba ha abɛnya nsuo bebree.

reference: Na Sikri, Efraim dɔmmarima bi, kumm ɔhene ba Maaseia ne ahemfie bapɔmma Asrikam ne Elkana a ɔdi ɔhene akyire.
hypothesis: Nasekuri efiri dɔm barima bi kum ɔhene ba ma ase ne ahemfo bɔɔma asre kame ne ɛka naa odi ɔhene akyire.

reference: Asa ahennie ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, firi ahyɛaseɛ kɔsi awieeɛ no, wɔatwerɛ agu Yuda ne Israel ahemfo nwoma no mu.
hypothesis: Asaheneɛ no nsam nkaeɛ firi asaseɛ kɔ so awieɛ no. Wɔatwerɛ gu wie da ne edwa ahenfo nwoma no mu.

reference: Wɔbɛyɛ mo nkyɛnmu nkasɛɛ na wɔn anyame nso ayɛ mfidie ama mo.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa mu nkyɛn mu nkasa, na wɔ ɛnyame nso ayɛ mfidie ama mu.

reference: Na mmarima mpemdu a wɔayi wɔn Israel nyinaa mu no bɛfirii Gibea nkyɛn mu, na ɔko no mu yɛɛ den.
hypothesis: Mmarima mpim do a wɔayi wɔn asraa nyinaa mu no bɛfiri gu bea nkyɛn mu. Na ɔkuo no mu yɛ den.

reference: Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu sɛ ɛnyɛ Israel hene no ne no no, wɔsane firii n’akyi.
hypothesis: Nantease a ɛnam so asafoɔ hɔn ho sɛ ɛnyɛ adwira hɛn no ne no. Ɔsan firi n'akyi.

reference: Na ɔwɔ nuammarima a wɔyɛ Yehosafat mma, wɔn ne Asaria, Yehiel, Sakaria, Asaria, Mikael ne Sefatia.
hypothesis: Naa ɔmɛrima a wɔyɛ ɛho safatema. Wɔn ne aseɛ ria, ya hɛl, sakariya, asɔria, mikae ɛne sefaatea.

reference: Na afei masoma ɔbarima nyansafoɔ a ɔwɔ nhunumu a ɔne Huram-Abi.
hypothesis: Ahafei, mmasoma ɔbarima nyansafoɔ a ɔwɔ hɔn mu a ɔne huram abeɛ.

reference: Samson soa Gasa apono kɔ.
hypothesis: Sia, saa ɛsɛnsoa agasa pono kɔ.

reference: Na wɔn a wɔpamm ne tiri soɔ no nie: Sabad, Amonni baa Simeat ba ne Yehosabad, Moabni baa Simrit ba.
hypothesis: Wɔn a wɔpam ne tiri so anumie, subad, amɔni baa, simiat, ba ne ɛho subad. Wɔabɔni baa simlet ba.

reference: Na Ɔhene Hesekia ne Amos ba Odiyifoɔ Yesaia bɔɔ yei ho mpaeɛ na wɔteaa mu kyerɛɛ ɔsoro.
hypothesis: Ɔhene dzaakia ne mmɔdzeba. Ɔdi fɔ yɛdze abɔ yɛn ho mpaeɛ. Na ɔtea mu kyerɛ ɔsoro.

reference: Na wɔse: Momma yɛnsɔre na yɛnkɔ wɔn so, ɛfiri sɛ yɛahunu asase no, na hwɛ, ɛyɛ papaapa.
hypothesis: Nna wɔse moma yɛn sɔre na yɛnkɔ wɔn so efiri sɛ yɛn hun asaase no, na ahwɛ ɛyɛ papaapa.

reference: Sakaria rewuo no, nsɛm a ɔka twaa toɔ ne sɛ, “Awurade nhunu deɛ wɔreyɛ na ɔmma wɔmmu ho akonta!
hypothesis: Sakari awu no, nsam a ɔka twa atoɔ no sɛ, wɔde honu deɛ wɔreyɛ na ɔma wɔn mu ho akɔnta.

reference: Na wɔde anantwinini nson ne adwennini nson ne nnwammaa nson ne mpapo nson kɔbɔɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ maa ahennie no ne kronkronbea no ne Yuda.
hypothesis: Nantwene nson na adwene nson. Ne nneɛma nso ne mpapɔ nso kɔbɔɔ bɔ ne ho afɔdeɛ ma aheniiɛ no ne kurokoro bea no ne yuta.

reference: Na ɔde aboɔ a ne boɔ yɛ den duraa ɛdan no ho sɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ.
hypothesis: Aboa a ne boɔ yɛ din drae ɛdan no sɛ ahyehyɛ deɛ.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no tenaa Kanaanfoɔ, Hetifoɔ ne Amorifoɔ ne Perisifoɔ ne Hewifoɔ ne Yebusifoɔ no mu.
hypothesis: Asraafoɔ no tena a, Kɛnamfoɔ, hatifoɔ ne ammorifoɔ ne pɛɛsefoɔ ne harifoɔ ne yɛbusifoɔ no mu.

reference: Pepeaa nnua na wɔde samm Asɔredan no mu, na wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ amapa guu so, dii mmɛdua ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn adwinnie wɔ so.
hypothesis: Papia nnua na wɔde sam asɔredan no mu. Na wɔde sika kɔkɔɔ amapagu so de mmadua ne nkɔsɔnko so adwiniiɛ wɔ so.

reference: Ɛnna asafo no somaa akofoɔ no mu mmarima mpemdumienu, na wɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔkum Yabes-gileadfoɔ no ne mmaa ne mmɔfra nkrantɛ ano.
hypothesis: Asafo no mu so ma akofoɔ no mu mmarima mpim do mmienu na wɔrekɔ sɛ wɔn sɛ munko nkwakum yi abɛs gilladfoɔ no ne mmaa ne mmɔfra nkrantaa no.

reference: Wɔde Ɛpo no sii anafoɔ fam ne apueeɛ fam afasuo ahyiaeɛ no twɛtwɛwa so hɔ.

reference: Na wantwe sɛpɔ no amfiri ne yafunu no mu, na ɛpue firii akyire.
hypothesis: Wantwe sɛpɔ no a mfiri ne afunu no mu. Na ɛpua firi akyire.

reference: Mosene Sipor babarima Balak a na ɔyɛ Moabhene no?

reference: Na mmarima mpemdu a wɔayi wɔn Israel nyinaa mu no bɛfirii Gibea nkyɛn mu, na ɔko no mu yɛɛ den.

reference: Wɔwɔ Mika fie ho no, wɔtee aberanteɛ Lewini no nne, na wɔmanee hɔ, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwan na ɔde wo baa ha?

reference: Mo mu biara a ɔwɔ ha a ɔbɛtumi no, AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn nni n’akyi, na ɔmforo nkɔ.

reference: Sɛ obi susu sɛ ɔyɛ Onyamesomfoɔ na wanto ne tɛkrɛma nnareka a, ne nyamesom no ho nni mfasoɔ na ɔdaadaa ne ho nso.

reference: Afei, Hesekia kyekyɛɛ asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ no mu akuakuo, sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, sɛ wɔnsom, na wɔmfa aseda ne nkamfo mma Awurade wɔ Asɔredan no apono ano.

reference: Ɔhene no ne Yehoiada de sika no maa adansie sohwɛfoɔ, ma wɔfaa adansifoɔ ne nnua dwumfoɔ, ma wɔsiesiee Awurade Asɔredan no.

reference: Ɛda no, Debora ne Abinoam babarima Barak too saa dwom yi: “Israel mpanimfoɔ sɔre dii animu.

reference: Nanso, nʼase no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Montie!
hypothesis: Nnanso n'ase no kakyɛ no sɛ, munte, adeɛ reyɛ asa, munte no, na munye mu ani anadwe yi. Ɔtena bubɛtumi asiemu anɔpahemma. Nnanso afei deɛ, ɔbarima no pɛ sɛ .

reference: Na ɔmaa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu ɔbarima kwantenni no, kuro no abɔntene so, na akɔkoraa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛhe na worekorɔ, na ɛhe nso na wofire?

reference: Ɔduruu ɔbaa no agya fie no, ɔde no kɔɔ efie no mu maa nʼagya no gyee no fɛ so.

reference: Enti, Lewifoɔ no ne nnipa no yɛɛ biribiara a ɔsɔfoɔ Yehoiada hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.

reference: Na asase no sofoɔ nyinaa ani gyee, na kuro no mu dwoe.
hypothesis: Asasewisifoɔ nyinaa ani gyee, na kuro no mu dwerɛe.

reference: Na na Lewifoɔ no akoma tene sene asɔfoɔ no wɔn ho kronkronyɛ no mu.
hypothesis: Nananayifoɔ n'akomu atene sene asɔfoɔ no, wɔn ho konko yɛ num.

reference: Nanso, nʼahennie mu no, wammubu abosonsomfoɔ asɔreeɛ no, na ɔmanfoɔ no nso amfa wɔn akoma nyinaa amma wɔn agyanom Onyankopɔn no.

reference: Na Israel mma no nyinaa hunuu sɛ ogya ne AWURADE animuonyam aba efie no soɔ no, wɔde wɔn anim butubutuu fam aboɔ nsɛeɛ no so sɔree, na wɔdaa AWURADE ase sɛ.
hypothesis: Adzrama no nyinaa ho sɛ ogya ne awuradeɛ mu ndzɛmba abɛ fie no soɔ no. Wɔde wɔn anim butubutu fam aboɔ nsɛeɛ no so sɔre. Na wɔde awuradeɛ asesɛe.

reference: Yeinom ne akodɔm a wɔtenaa Yerusalem somm ɔhene no, ne wɔn a Yehosafat de wɔn duaduaa nkuro a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ Yudaman mu.
hypothesis: Yeanum ne akodɔm a wɔtena yɛwisalam som ɔhene no ne wɔn a yɛwisafat de wɔn dua dua nkuro a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ wudaman mu.

reference: Monhwɛ yie na monyɛ, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn no, nkontompo ne animhwɛ ne kɛtɛ-asehyɛ nni ne fam.
hypothesis: Mmɔn hwɛ yie na amonyɛ afiri sɛ ɛwura de yɛn nyɛnko pɔn no, nkontɔnpɔn ne animhwɛ ne kata ahyehyɛ ne ne fam.

reference: Na Onyankopɔn abufuo baa Yuda ne Yerusalem so wɔ wɔn bɔne enti.

reference: Na wɔwieeɛ no, wɔde sika no nkaeɛ baa ɔhene ne Yehoiada anim, na wɔde yɛɛ nnoɔma maa AWURADE fie, ɔsom ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ho nnoɔma ne nkoraa ne sika ne dwetɛ nnoɔma no.
hypothesis: Wɔ wie no, wɔde sika no nkaeɛ ba ɔhene ne yehɔɔda anim, na wɔde nneɛma ma awurade fie. Ɔsom ne ɔhyia afadeɛ no ho nneɛma ne nkwadaa ne sika ne dwetɛ nneɛma no.

reference: Na Yudahene Yehosafat sane baa ne fie asomdwoeɛ mu wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Wie da hene yi ho safad sane baa na fi asomdwa mu wɔ yɛresalam.

reference: Yosia hyɛɛ aseɛ hwehwɛɛ ne tete agya Dawid Onyankopɔn akyiri ɛkwan wɔ ɛberɛ a na ɔda so yɛ abɔfra a wadi adeɛ mfeɛ nwɔtwe.
hypothesis: Dwadzi ahyɛase ahwehwɛ a ne ti te gya dawid. Ogya akopɔn akyirɛ kwan wɔ berɛ a na ɔda so yɛ abɔfra a wɔadi adeɛ mfie nwɔtwe.

reference: Nhyira nka onipa a ɔnya gyidie wɔ amanehunu mu, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔno na ɔbɛnya akyɛdeɛ a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ho bɔ ama wɔn a wɔdɔ no no.

reference: Nso ɛnyɛ wo na wobɛsi dan no, na wo ba a ɔfiri w’asene mu no, ɔno na ɔbɛsi dan ama me din.
hypothesis: Nya wo na wo besi dan no na wo ba a ofiri wɔ asene mu ɔno na ɔbesi dan amamɛdi.

reference: Sɛ nnanson apontoɔ yi mu, motumi yi ano a, mɛma mo serekyetam ntadeɛ aduasa ne ntadeɛ ahodoɔ bi nso aduasa.
hypothesis: Sɛn nanso apontoɔ yi mu, butumi yi anoa. Mmarima mu sere kyerɛ tam ntaadeɛ aduasa, ne ntaadeɛ ahodoɔ bi nso aduasa.

reference: Na ɔbɔɔ no mpaeɛ no, AWURADE tiee ne nkotosrɛ, na ɔde no sane baa Yerusalem n’ahennie mu.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa no mpaeɛ no, na nwura de tie ne nkotosrɛ, na de ne san no ba yɛlo sɛlm na ahenia mu.

reference: Na ɔyɛɛ ɛdan no anim adum mmienu, n’atentene, basafa dunson ne fa, na aduntire a ɛwɔ atifi no basafa mmienu ne fa.
hypothesis: Ɛdan no anim adum mmienu. Na tenten, basafadu nso ne fa. Na aduntire a ɛwɔ atifi no basafamienu ne fa.

reference: Na mpoma no woware ma wɔhunu mpoma no ti, adaka no ho, mpiakyire no anim, na wɔnhunu wɔ adihɔ hɔ, na ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ da yi.

reference: Ham na ɔne Israel hameeɛ anaasɛ ko na ɔne wɔn koeɛ?

reference: Mokɔ a, mobɛto ɔman a wɔte hɔ dwoodwoo; asase no so, na Onyankopɔn de ahyɛ mo nsa; baabi a asase so adeɛ biara nyɛ na hɔ.
hypothesis: Moko a ɔrebɛto ɔman a wɔte hɔ dwodwo asaase no so. Na onyanko pɔn de ahyɛ wɔn nsa. Baabi a asaase so adeɛ biara nye na hɔ.

reference: Na wɔduruu Timna bobe nturo ho, na hwɛ, gyataburuwa bi boboom hyiaa no.
hypothesis: Odze rutim na abobɛnturo ho, na ahyɛ gyata browa bi gu bowl mu hyia no.

reference: Na ɔno deɛ, ɔbuu Israel atɛn mfirinhyia aduonu.
hypothesis: Ɔno deɛ obi srɛ atɛn mfirihyia aduom.

reference: Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu sɛ ɛnyɛ Israel hene no ne no no, wɔsane firii n’akyi.
hypothesis: Nantease a ɛnam so asafoɔ hɔn ho sɛ ɛnyɛ adwira hɛn no ne no. Ɔsan firi n'akyi.

reference: Na ɔde ɛpo no sii atɔeɛ fa a ɛkyerɛ apueeɛ no.
hypothesis: Ɔde ɛpo no si atɔyɛ fa a ɛkyerɛ ɛpo yɛ.

reference: wɔammɛboa Awurade anko antia akofoɔ ahoɔdenfoɔ no.
hypothesis: Wɔamamua nwuraade a nkontia ɔkofoɔ ahoɔdenfoɔ no.

reference: Na wɔkyekyeree kuro no tenaa mu, na wɔtoo kuro no din Dan, sɛdeɛ wɔn agya Dan a wɔwoo no maa Israel no din teɛ; nanso anka akane no na kuro no din de Lais.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Afei sɛ manya w’anim animuonyam a, ɛnneɛ yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi kyerɛ me, sɛ ɛyɛ wo na wo ne me rekasa yi.

reference: Na Yuda man no nyinaa faa Usia, na wadi mfirinhyia dunsia, na wɔsii no hene n’agya Amasia ananmu.
hypothesis: Wi daman no nyinaa afa wudzi a na wɔde mfirihyia adu nsia. Na wosi ne hwene no agya amɛɛse anan mu.

reference: Amonfoɔ no de nnoɔma bi brɛɛ no afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu nso.

reference: Na Hesekia kaa sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia no so.
hypothesis: Mmaadakia aka asɛ wɔn a ɔhyiafoɔ deɛ afɔrobukyia no so.

reference: Na ɔde dɔm duaduaa Yuda nkuro a ɛyɛ den nyinaa mu, na ɔde bansifoɔ duaduaa Yuda asase so, ne Efraim nkuro a n’agya Asa gyeeɛ no mu.
hypothesis: Nɔde dɔm duaduayi da nkuro a adi nyinaa mu na ɔde benyifoɔ duaduaduayi da asaase so ne firim nkoro anagya asa gyeyɛ ne mu.

reference: Yei akyi no, Moabfoɔ, Amonfoɔ ne Maonfoɔ asraafoɔ bi tuu Yehosafat so sa.
hypothesis: Yei akyi no, mmoafoɔ, ammɔfoɔ ne mmoafoɔ asrafoɔ bi tu yɛ osu afasosu.

reference: Na ɔtetee nhoma no mu sɛdeɛ ogya ka firaeɛ a, ɛteteɛ no.

reference: Na ne din de Yahasiel a ɔyɛ Sakaria babarima a ɔno nso yɛ Benaia babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Yeiel babarima, na ɔno nso yɛ Lewini Matania, a ɔyɛ Asaf aseni no babarima.

reference: Ɔsuaa deɛ ɛnam so maa Awurade pamoo abosonsomfoɔ no firii asase a ɛda Israel anim no so no.
hypothesis: Abusua adeɛ nam so ma ɛwɔ ade pam abɔtosofoɔ no firi asase a ɛda dwa anim no so no.

reference: Na wɔhunuu Adoni-besek wɔ Besek, na wɔne no koe, na wɔkumm Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ no.
hypothesis: Ɔhunu adɔn no bi sɛ kɔbesek na ɔne no kɔn. Na ɔkum kɛnnamfoɔ ne pɛɛsefoɔ no.

reference: Na ɔdedaa no ne nankoroma so, na ɔfrɛɛ ɔbarima bi maa no bɛyii ne tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson no, na ɔfirii aseɛ brɛɛ no ase, na n’ahoɔden no firii ne ho kɔe.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Filistifoɔ wɔ wo so oo, Samson!
hypothesis: Akakyerɛ no sɛ polisifoɔ a ahosuo samsen.

reference: Amonom hɔ ara, Awurade Honhom baa ne so wɔ ahoɔden mu, na ɔde ne nsa hunu waee gyata no apantan.
hypothesis: Amonom hɔ ara. Waade hohu ban no so wɔ ahoɔden mu, na ɔde ne nsa honu wɔre gyata no apantae.

reference: Na asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na yɛbɛyɛ ama wɔn a wɔaka no ɛyerenom fam?

reference: Saa nyansa yi mfiri soro, na mmom ɛyɛ fam ne ɔkra ne ahonhommɔne deɛ.
hypothesis: Saa nyansa yi mfiri soro. Na ɛma mu, ɛyɛ fam ne ɔkra ne ahohɔnɔdeɛ.

reference: Yei da no adi pefee sɛ Onyankopɔn nam onipa nneyɛeɛ so na ɔbu no bem, na ɛnnam ne gyidie nko so.
hypothesis: Yei da nnadeɛ pefin sɛ onyanko pɔn nam onipa no yɛ so na obi no bɛm. Na ɛnam ne gyideɛ nkɔ so.

reference: Na ɔte sɛ Onyankopɔn abɔfoɔ no mu baako a ne ho yɛ hu yie.
hypothesis: Ɔte sɛ onyanko pono abɔ fa no mu baako a ne ho yɛ hu yie.

reference: Ɛfiri sɛ, mabue m’ano mama AWURADE, na mentumi mensane m’akyi.
hypothesis: Efiri sɛ mɛbue mu a no mmaa aduade. Na mentu mmienu nsa ɛma akyi.

reference: ” Afei ɔfiri hɔ kɔeɛ, kɔkyeree asakraman ahasa.

reference: Na ɔbarima bi wɔ hɔ a ɔfiri Sora a ɔfiri Danfoɔ abusua bi mu a ne din de Manoa; na ne yere yɛ obonini, na ɔnwo.

reference: Na ɔhunuu sɛ ɔhene foforɔ no gyina nʼafa baabi wɔ afadum no ho wɔ Asɔredan no kwan ano a ɛkyerɛ ne tumi.

reference: ” Na sɛ woansɛe awadeɛ na wodi awu a, woabu mmara so.

reference: Mokɔ a, mobɛto ɔman a wɔte hɔ dwoodwoo; asase no so, na Onyankopɔn de ahyɛ mo nsa; baabi a asase so adeɛ biara nyɛ na hɔ.

reference: Na Atalia, ɔbɔnefoɔ no mma ahyɛne Nyankopɔn fie no mu, na AWURADE fie akronkronneɛ nyinaa nso, wɔahwere ama Baalim.

reference: Na wɔbɛka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ: Ɛdɔm kɛseɛ bi firi po no agya firi Edom reba wo so, na hwɛ, wɔwɔ Hasason-tamar .

reference: Na wɔbɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ AWURADE fie daa daa Yehoiada berɛ so nyinaa.

reference: Na yɛnni ɔsɔfo panin a ɔnnim yɛn mmerɛyɛ na ɔnni tema mma yɛn, na mmom deɛ wɔasɔ no ahwɛ adeɛ nyinaa mu sɛ yɛn ara, nso wannyɛ bɔne.

reference: Na sɛ akɔnnɔ no nyinsɛn a, ɛwo bɔne, na bɔne no nyini a ɛwo owuo.

reference: sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn aka sɛ, “Enti mefiri mʼabufuo mu ka ntam sɛ.

hypothesis: Nnipa bi wɔn mu. Wɔn nyinaa a wɔn nyinaa bi wɔn nyinaa. Wɔn nyinaa bi a wɔn nyinaa ayɛ atwa wɔn akyi. Na wɔn nyinaa ayɛ a wɔn nyinaa ayɛ.

reference: Na ɔkyɛɛ mmarima ahasa no mu akuo mmiɛnsa, na ɔde ntotorobɛnto hyehyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa nsa ne nkuruwa hunu ne tɛnee a ɛhyehyɛ nkuruwa no mu.
hypothesis: Ɔkyɛ mmarima a asan no mu wɔ kuo mmiɛnsa. Na ɔde ntotorobɛnto hyehyɛ a wɔn nyinaa nsa ne nkuruwa ahunu ne tɛnnea a ɛhyehyɛ nkuruwa no mu.

reference: Na Arabfoɔ afomfafoɔ akuo akunkum mmammarima mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa.
hypothesis: Ahaafoɔ afofofofoɔ akuku mma mmarima mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa.

reference: Na wɔde nnafua nwɔtwe bio dwiraa Awurade Asɔredan no ankasa.

reference: Sɛ wɔsɔ obi hwɛ a, mma no nnka sɛ: Onyankopɔn na ɔsɔ me hwɛ.
hypothesis: Sɛ wɔso obi hwea, ma no nka sɛ onyanko pɔn na ɔsɔ mmɛhwe.

reference: Wo bo bɛfu wɔn ama wɔn atamfoɔ adi wɔn so, afa wɔn nkoa de wɔn akɔ ananasase so, sɛ ɛwɔ akyiri anaa ɛbɛn.

reference: Enti deɛ ɔnim papayɛ na ɔnyɛ no, ɛyɛ bɔne ma no.

reference: Nanso Yosia annane n’ani amfiri ne ho, na mmom ɔsakyeraa ne ho sɛ ɔne no rekɔko, na wantie Neko nsɛm a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn anomu no.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Monka nkyerɛ yɛn, ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wɔyɛɛ bɔne a ɛte seyie?
hypothesis: Asraafoɔ no kaasɛ, muka nkyerɛ yɛ, ɛyɛ dan na ɔyɛ borɔne a ɛte sɛ yie.

reference: Na Lewifoɔ no ntwa ɔhene ho nhyia, wɔn akodeɛ nkurakura wɔn nsam.
hypothesis: Alebifoɔ no atwa ɔhene ho ahyia. Wɔn akodeɛ nkurakura wɔn nsam.

reference: Saa kwadwom yi abɛyɛ amanneɛ a wɔatwerɛ ahyɛ Kwadwom Nwoma mu.
hypothesis: Saa akwadwa mu yi abɛyɛ amaneɛ a wɔatwerɛ ahyɛ kwadwa mu nhoma no mu.

reference: Akane no na Debir din ne Kiriat-sefer.
hypothesis: Akane no na deɛ bɛdi ne kiri atsefa.

reference: Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Manase nyinaa na wɔn nso hyia bɛdii n’akyi.
hypothesis: Ɔsima abɔfoɔ ma ɔkɔɔ ma nan asɛ nyinaa na wɔn so hyiɛ abɛdi n'akyi.

reference: Na ɔsɔree anadwo na ɔkɔkum Edomfoɔ a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia ne nteaseɛnam so asafohene no.
hypothesis: Ɔsɔre anadwo, na kokumadɔmfoɔ a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia ne teaseɛnam so asafoɛ no.

reference: Nso na Benyaminfoɔ no nnim sɛ amaneɛ rebɛto wɔn.
hypothesis: Nsonabɛyɛ amanfoɔ no anim sɛ amaneɛ bɛtoɔ.

reference: Ɔdii ahyɛdeɛ a Awurade nam Gad, a ɔyɛ ɔhene nhunumuni ne odiyifoɔ Natan so de maa Dawid no so.

reference: Na Yosia yiyii akyiwadeɛ no nyinaa firii nsase a ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ deɛ no nyinaa so, na ɔde wɔn a wɔwɔ Israel no nyinaa hyɛɛ ɔsom no mu maa wɔsom AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn.
hypothesis: Nnwisie a wɔreyɛ kyiwa adeɛ no nyinaa firi asaase a ɛyɛ adraadeɛ no nyinaa so. Na wɔde wɔn a wɔwɔ adraade no nyinaa hyɛ ɔson no mu ma wɔsom adwura deɛ wɔn nyinaa wɔpɔn.

reference: Na sɛ mohwɛ nnipa anim de gye wɔn a, modi ho fɔ na Mmara no tia mo sɛ mmaratofoɔ.

reference: Na ɔyii ananafoɔ anyame ne ahoni no firii AWURADE fie ne afɔrebukyia a ɔsisii no AWURADE fie bepɔ soɔ ne Yerusalem no nyinaa, na ɔkɔtoto guu kuro no akyi.

reference: Nso Odiyifoɔbaa Debora a ɔyɛ Lapidot yere na na ɔbu Israel atɛn saa berɛ no.

reference: Na hwɛ, obiara amfiri Yabes-gilead amma badwa no mu, nsraban no mu.
hypothesis: N'ahwɛ obiara firi yɛabɛdzi gilad a mmaa bɛdwa no mu nsraban no mu.

reference: Nanso, wansɛ nʼagya Manase, ɛfiri sɛ, wammrɛ ne ho ase amma Awurade.
hypothesis: Danso wɔn se ne gyama no ase afiri sɛ wɔammerɛ no ho ase ama awurade.

reference: Na Samson kaa sɛ: Ma me ne Filistifoɔ no nwuwu!
hypothesis: Asamsee kaase maame ne filisifoɔ no mu.

reference: Ɛnneɛ na homedadie da so ara wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn man.
hypothesis: Ɛneɛ n'ahome dadeɛ da soa wɔ hɔ ma onya nkɔpɔn man.

reference: Na sɛdeɛ nipadua a honhom nni mu awuo no, saa ara nso na gyidie a nnwuma nni mu awuo.
hypothesis: Sɛdeɛ nnipadua a ɛhohɔ no mu awuro no. Saa nso na gye deɛ a nnwuma no mu awuro.

reference: Nanso, ɔbaa no anni no nokorɛ enti ɔsane kɔɔ nʼagya fie wɔ Betlehem.
hypothesis: Aha nso ɔbaa no ɛnni no nkranti. Ɔsane kɔn na egya fie wɔ bɛtlɛɛm.

reference: Gilead te Yordan agya; na Dan deɛ, adɛn nti na ɔne ahyɛn teɛ?
hypothesis: Gyaleate yɔda na gya, na dandeɛ, adeɛntene a ɔne ahyɛn tie.

reference: Hwɛ, wobɛto wo kɔn awu, na wɔasie wo wɔ da mu asomdwoeɛ mu, na adebɔne a mede mereba ha yi ne ɛhafoɔ soɔ no nyinaa deɛ w’ani renhunu.

reference: Yehoiakim dii adeɛ no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu enum, na ɔdii ɔhene Yerusalem mfirinhyia dubaako.

reference: Na saa Melkisedek yi, Salem hene, Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn sɔfoɔ, Abraham kɔkumm ahene no na ɔresane aba no, ɔkɔhyiaa no hyiraa no.

reference: Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria dii n’akyi, na AWURADE asɔfoɔ aduɔwɔtwe, nnipa a wɔtumi wɔn ho ka ne ho.
hypothesis: Nɔsɔfoɔ asɛre agye n'akyi. Na wɔde asɔfoɔ adu a wɔtwe. Nnipa a wɔtumi a wɔreka no ho.

reference: Yuda ne Yerusalem, monnsuro na mo akoma nntu, ɔkyena momfiri adi nkɔhyia wɔn, na AWURADE bɛdi mo akyi.

reference: Nso akyinnyeɛ biara nni mu sɛ deɛ ɔkyɛne soɔ no na ɔhyira akumaa.

reference: Na Hesekia hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnsiesie mpumpunu AWURADE fie; na wɔsiesiee, na wɔde mmasoɔ adeɛ no ne ntotosoɔ du du no ne akronkronneɛ no hyɛɛ hɔ nokorɛdie so.

reference: Ɛnsɛ sɛ saa onipa no susu sɛ ɔbɛnya biribiara afiri Awurade nkyɛn; nʼadwene yɛ no ntanta a ɔntumi nsi biribiara pi.

reference: Mo a moka sɛ: Ɛnnɛ ne ɔkyena yɛbɛkɔ sɛɛ ne sɛɛ kuro yi mu akɔdi hɔ afe, na yɛatɔ atɔn na yɛanya mfasoɔ.

reference: Na ɔhwɛ ne ho na ɔkɔ, na ntɛm ara na ne werɛ afiri su ko a ɔkura.
hypothesis: Ɔhwɛ ne ho na ɔkɔ na ntɛmmuwa na ne nwura fi sukuu a ɔkura.

reference: Ne nneyɛeɛ maa Onyankopɔn buu no bem, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔgyee Yudafoɔ bi a wɔsomaa wɔn, boaa wɔn ma wɔdwane faa ɛkwan foforɔ bi so.

reference: Na deɛ wɔkari de yɛɛ nnadewa no ano si sika nnwetɛbena aduonum.
hypothesis: Adeɛ ɔka redi yɛ n'adua ano si sika nwɔtɛbuna aduom.

reference: Ɔdii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dunsia wɔ Yerusalem.

reference: Abɔfoɔ no kyinii nkuro a ɛwɔ Efraim ne Manase kɔsi Sebulon so.

reference: Nanso, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Ɛyɛ sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosi asɔredan de hyɛ me din animuonyam nanso, ɛnyɛ wo na wobɛyɛ.

reference: Enti momma yɛmmɔ mmɔden nhyɛne ɔhome no mu, na obi anhwe ase anyɛ asoɔden korɔ no ara ho nhwɛsoɔ.

reference: Saa ɛberɛ yi, na asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa, sɛ wɔwɔ dwuma bi die anaa wɔnni hwee yɛ, adwira wɔn ho.

reference: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛ komm, fa wo nsa mua w’ano na ɛne yɛn nkɔ, na yɛ yɛn agya ne ɔsɔfoɔ.

reference: Wɔn agya maa wɔn mu biara akyɛdeɛ a ɛsom bo, a ɛyɛ dwetɛ, sikakɔkɔɔ ne aboɔdenneɛ, na afei, ɔde Yuda nkuro a wɔabɔ ho ban no bi kyekyɛɛ wɔn.
