reference: Na Samson kaa sɛ: Ma me ne Filistifoɔ no nwuwu!
hypothesis: Asamsee kaase maame ne filisifoɔ no mu.

reference: Na wɔfaa adaka no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne akronkronneɛ a ɛwɔ ntomadan no mu nyinaa bae; Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no na wɔde foro baeɛ.
hypothesis: Nawɔfɔ adaka no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne akronkroniɛ a ɛwɔ ntomadan no mu nyinaa ban. Lɔwifoɔ asɔfoɔ no na wɔde foro ban.

reference: W’asɔfoɔ no, AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ma wɔnhyɛ nkwagyeɛ.
hypothesis: Wɔasɔfoɔ no, awurade nyɛangopɔn ma wɔnhyɛ nkwadie.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ampa, mɛdi w’akyi na woakum Midian sɛ onipa baako.
hypothesis: Nnadeɛ kɛtrɛ no sɛ ampa. Mmɛdi wɔ akyi na wɔakum media asɛ onipa baako.

reference: Nanso, Samson ka kyerɛɛ nʼagya sɛ, “Kɔyɛ ne ho adeɛ ma me.
hypothesis: Nnanso samsen kɛkyɛɛ n'egya sɛ kɔyɛ ne ho adeɛ ma ma.

reference: Nnipa a wɔyɛɛ bɔne na wɔtete hwe wuwuu wɔ ɛserɛ so no.
hypothesis: Nnipa a wɔyɛ borɔne no wɔtete hwe wuu wɔ serɛ so no.

reference: Na wo ara, wo nko ara na wonim nnipa mma akoma mu, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔasuro woɔ, na woanante w’akwan soɔ nna a wɔde bɛtena asase a wode maa yɛn agyanom no soɔ no nyinaa.
hypothesis: Nkwadaa na wɔnim nnipa ma akomamu. Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ no ara wɔ soro wɔ na wɔn renante wɔn akwan so na wɔde bɛtena asaase a wɔde ma yɛn agyanom so nyinaa.

reference: Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sei na monyɛ wɔ AWURADE ho suro mu, nokorɛ ne mo akoma mu.
hypothesis: Ɔhyɛ wɔn nsa sei nam nya wɔn ade ho soro mu. N'akura no mu akomamu.

reference: Na afei masoma ɔbarima nyansafoɔ a ɔwɔ nhunumu a ɔne Huram-Abi.
hypothesis: Ahafei, mmasoma ɔbarima nyansafoɔ a ɔwɔ hɔn mu a ɔne huram abeɛ.

reference: Mɛma wɔayɛ nsɛsodeɛ ne ohoni a wɔagu de ahyɛ me babarima animuonyam.
hypothesis: Mmarima a wɔyɛ nsɛsodeɛ ne ohonin a wɔagu deɛ ahyɛm ɛba barima animanya.

reference: Na Yerusalem nso, Yehosafat de Lewifoɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne Israel agyanom atitire no mu binom sisii AWURADE atemmuo ne asennie so.
hypothesis: Ayaresalam nso, ɛho safat de lawifoɔ ne asɔfoɔ no reyere a egya no te tirinom bi nom sisi. Awuradeɛ ataa mu ne asɛdeɛ so.

reference: “Merebrɛ wo odwumfoɔ a ne nsa ano adwuma yɛ fɛ a wɔfrɛ no Huram-Abi.
hypothesis: Mmabra ɔwɔ dwumfoɔ a ne saa no adwuma yɛ fɛ a wɔfrɛ no huram abeɛ.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Aaron mma, asɔfoɔ no, sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ AWURADE afɔrebukyia no so.
hypothesis: Ɔka kyerɛ awurɔma. Asɔfoɔ no sɛ wɔn ɔhyia afadeɛ wɔ awurade afɔ rebukyia no so.

reference: Na ɔte Debora kyiresua ase, Rama ne Betel ntam, Efraim bepɔ so; na Israelfoɔ foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmu wɔn atɛn.
hypothesis: Nɔɔte dawur a kyerɛ suase. Rɔma ne bɛtɛ ntam efiri mmepɔ so. Na asraafoɔ no forɔbae ne nkyɛnsee a ɔmo wɔ atɛn.

reference: Na ɛpo no si wɔn so ɔsoro, na wɔn akyiri nyinaa wɔ emu fam.
hypothesis: Nɛpo no si wɔn so ɔsoro. Na wɔn akyi nyinaa wɔ ɛmu fam.

reference: Ɛnna ɔhene no frɛɛ Ɔpanin Yehoiada, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na womma Lewifoɔ no nnye Yuda ne Yerusalem toɔ a AWURADE akoa Mose ne Israel badwa no hyɛ maa adanseɛ ntomadan no?
hypothesis: Ɛna ahen no frɛɛ ɔpanin yi hɔ ada, na ɔka kyerɛ no sɛn. Adan tena wɔn alawifoɔ no anyi yi dadeɛ ne yɛresamtoa a awuradeɛ akɔ wɔn a osi. Ne dza ɛbɛdwa hyɛ ma adansie ntoma dan no.

reference: Na Gileadni Yefta yɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛ nnam, nanso ɔyɛ ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ bi ba, na Gilead na ɔwoo Yefta.
hypothesis: Giilad ne yɛfitae ɔbarima a ɔyɛ nam. Na nso ɔyɛ ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ bi ba. Na gilad na ɔwɔ yɛfitae.

reference: Asɔrefie sie no mfitiaseɛ.
hypothesis: Abaa a ɛtɔ so mmienu te mmiɛnsa. Asɔre fie si enum fiti aseɛ.

reference: Na Gideon hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE bɔfoɔ no, Gideon kaa sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn!
hypothesis: Agyina a ɔwura yɛ ade bɔfoɔ no, gye dɔnka asɛɛ, awɔɔ ade nyanko pɔn.

reference: Ɛberɛ a Amonfoɔ to hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ so, Gilead mpanimfoɔ soma kɔfaa Yefta firii Tob asase so baeɛ.
hypothesis: Ɛberɛ a amonfoɔ to hyɛ edwurafoɔ so. Giller mpanimfoɔ soa, nkurɔfoɔ a yɛfita firi toba asɛse so ban.

reference: Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔsom ɔhene no, ɛsono wɔn a ɔhene de wɔn duaduaa Yuda nyinaa mu nkuro a ɛyɛ den no mu no.
hypothesis: Yeanum ne wɔn a wɔsom ɔhene no. Ɛso wɔn a ɔhene de wɔn duadua yi da nyinaa mu nkuro ayɛ dan no mu no.

reference: Na Sisera maa wɔkɔpae hyiahyiaa ne nteaseɛnam a ɛyɛ dadeɛ nteaseɛnam ahankron no nyinaa ne ɔman a wɔka ne ho nyinaa de firi Haroset-hagoyim baa Kison nsunoa.
hypothesis: Dadesɛsɛr ama ɔkɔpa ahyia a ne teaseɛnam ɛyɛ dadeɛ a teaseɛnam aha nkron no nyinaa ne ɔman a ɔka ne ho nyinaa de firi. Haro sɛt hago yi mu, baako sɔ nsu noa.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Misraimfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidonfoɔ, Amalekfoɔ ne Maonfoɔ anhyɛ mo so!
hypothesis: Nnade katerɛ asraafoɔ sɛ mbasirifoɔ, amɔfoɔ, amɔfoɔ, afilisifoɔ, sidɔmfoɔ, amɛlikifoɔ ne mmoa mfoɔ a nhyɛ mu so.

reference: Ɔno deɛ, honam nsa na ɛne no wɔ hɔ, na yɛn deɛ, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn na ɔne yɛn wɔ hɔ, sɛ ɔbɛboa yɛn na wako yɛn ko ama yɛn.
hypothesis: Ɔno deɛ ɔnam nsa na ɛne no wɔ hɔ, na yɛn deɛ, nwura deɛ nyea nko pɔ na ɔne yɛn wɔ hɔ. Saa ɔbɛboa yɛ no akonnwa nko ama yɛn.

reference: Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ saa, anadwo no, na enwi no nko woe, na fam hɔ nyinaa, obosuo tɔ guu hɔ.
hypothesis: Nnɔnya ɔkɔɔ yɛ saa anadwono na ɛwii no nko wɔ yi na fam hɔ nyinaa ɔbɔ so tɔ gu hɔ.

reference: Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Aser ne Sebulon ne Naftali, na wɔforo ba bɛhyiaa no.
hypothesis: Ɔsomma abɔfoɔ ma ɔkɔ asa ne sɛ bronin naftali na ɔforo ba besia no.

reference: Na ɔte Debora kyiresua ase, Rama ne Betel ntam, Efraim bepɔ so; na Israelfoɔ foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmu wɔn atɛn.
hypothesis: Nɔɔte dawur a kyerɛ suase. Rɔma ne bɛtɛ ntam efiri mmepɔ so. Na asraafoɔ no forɔbae ne nkyɛnsee a ɔmo wɔ atɛn.

reference: Na hwɛ, na Sisera da hɔ awu, na pɛɛwa no tua n’asontorɔ mu.
hypothesis: N'ahwɛ, n'asesa da hɔ awu, na pɛɛwa no tua n'asunturom.

reference: Ɛnna ɔman no de wɔn ho too Yudahene Hesekia nsɛm no soɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔman no de wɔn ho toɔ yiudahene hwɛdzeakia nsɛm no so.

reference: Kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a wɔde dii dwuma no dodoɔ enti, wɔantumi anhunu emu duru ano.
hypothesis: Kɔɔber mfrafraeɛ a wɔde di dwuma no dodoɔ nti. Wɔn tiri me ehu ɛmu duro ano.

reference: Asɔredan a merebɛsi no kɛseɛ ne ne fɛ a ɛbɛyɛ enti, nnua bebree ho bɛhia me.
hypothesis: Asɔredan a mebesi no kɛseɛ ne ne fɛ a ɛbɛyɛ nti. Nnua bebree ho bɛyia me.

reference: Ɛnna wɔfaa safoa de hiniiɛ, na hwɛ, na wɔn wura da fam awu.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔfa asafoɔ ade hi no nyinaa hwe na ɔnwura da famu awu.

reference: Na wɔhwiee sika a wɔhunuu no AWURADE fie no guu hɔ, na wɔde hyɛɛ ahwɛfoɔ no ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no nsa.
hypothesis: Wɔ fie esi kaa a wohu no, nwuraade fie no gu hɔ. Na wɔde hyɛ ahwɛfoɔ no ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no nsa.

reference: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ yii ne ho kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woyɛ obonini na wonwo, nanso wobɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima.
hypothesis: Nɛwuradebɔfoɔ yi na wɔrekyerɛ ɔbaa no. Na ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ hwɛ. Wɔrebɔ ni na wɔho na nso banyin sia wɔ ɔbaa barima.

reference: Na Amorifoɔ hyeɛ firi Akrabim aforoeɛ, ɛfiri Sela rekorɔ no.
hypothesis: Nammɔfoɔ hyɛ afiri. Akrabim aforɔeɛ. Afiri sɛla ɛkoro no.

reference: Na ɔne wɔn tenaa Nyankopɔn fie, huntaa mfeɛ nsia.
hypothesis: Ɔne hɔn tsena nyankopɔn fie. Hɔn taa efie nsia.

reference: Mfeɛ dunwɔtwe na wɔdii Israelfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yordan agya, Amorifoɔ asase soɔ wɔ Gilead no nyinaa soɔ.
hypothesis: Mfie nohoa atwen a wɔde resra a wɔwɔ yɛɛdan agya. Hammɔɔrefoɔ asaase soɔ wɔ gillad no nyinaa so.

reference: Enti, Awurade abufuo baa ɔno, Yuda ne Yerusalem nyinaa so.
hypothesis: Nti adwadeɛ abufoɔ baa ɔno, wɔda ne yɛresa mu nyinaa so.

reference: Ɔdaa hɔ ara kɔsii sɛ anim teteeɛ.
hypothesis: Wɔda kuro no abɔnten kɛseɛ so. Na obiara ahofɔn anko fie ankɔ so wɔn hɔ ho.

reference: Me nuanom monhwɛ yie na mo mu bi annya akoma bɔne a ɔrennye Onyankopɔn nni na ɛbɛma watwe ne ho afiri Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no ho.
hypothesis: Me nua no, mmo hwɛ yie, na mmo bi anya akɔmmuabɔ nea ɔnye wɔn nyanko pɔn nyi. Na ɔbarima watwe ne ho afiri wɔn nyanko pɔn teasefoɔ no ho.

reference: Momfa wɔn sɛ nhwɛsoɔ wɔ wɔn boasetɔ ne tumi a wɔtumi de tenaa amanehunu mu no.
hypothesis: Mmɔnfa wɔn sɛ nhwɛsoɔ wɔ wɔn bo asɛtɔ ne tummi a wɔtumi de tena ama ne ho no mu no.

reference: Ɛnna Amasia bisaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Na ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha a mede ama Israel asafo no?
hypothesis: Ɛna amɛsia bi saa nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ. Nea ɔde anigye kɛseɛ ɔhaa ma de ama ɛduruwae asafo no.

reference: Israelfoɔ no somm Moabhene Eglon mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe.
hypothesis: Adwadifoɔ no so mmoa pene agu lɔnfiri hyiadu wɔtwe.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Misraimfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidonfoɔ, Amalekfoɔ ne Maonfoɔ anhyɛ mo so!
hypothesis: Nnade katerɛ asraafoɔ sɛ mbasirifoɔ, amɔfoɔ, amɔfoɔ, afilisifoɔ, sidɔmfoɔ, amɛlikifoɔ ne mmoa mfoɔ a nhyɛ mu so.

reference: Mprɛnsa ni a woasisi me, na wonkyerɛɛ me adekodeɛ a w’ahoɔden kɛseɛ yi wɔ mu.
hypothesis: Mpɛnsa ni a wɔasisi me na wɔn kyerɛ me adekodeɛ a wɔn ho adan kɛseɛ yi wɔ mu.

reference: Ɛda bi, ɔde ɔbaa bi firi Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yuda baa fie sɛ ne mpena.
hypothesis: Ɛdan bi, ɔde ɔbaa bi firi bɛtlɛɛma a ɛwɔ yuda, ba efie sɛ ne mpena.

reference: Na wɔn mma deɛ, wankum wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara no mu, Mose nwoma mu no a AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ: Agyanom nnwu, mma nti, na mma nso nnwu, agyanom nti, na onipa no ara bɔne nti na wɔmma no nwuo.
hypothesis: Wɔma deɛ, wɔn kum wɔn. Saa deɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmeranom, wɔn sɛ wɔn mma mu no a awuraade hyɛ sɛ ɛgya no mu nwura nti, na mma nso nwura nti, na onipa no ara abɔ ne ti na wɔma no mu.

reference: Na wɔkɔfrɛɛ Samson firii apokyerɛfoɔ fie bae, na ɔgoroo wɔn anim, na wɔde no gyinaa adum no ntam.
hypothesis: Wɔrekɔfrɛ samsen firi abɔkyerɛfoɔ fie bae, na ɔregoro wɔn anim, na wɔde no gyina adum no ntam.

reference: Ɛnna AWURADE abufuo dɛre tiaa Israel, na ɔtɔn wɔn hyɛɛ Mesopotamia hene Kusan-risataim nsa, na Israelfoɔ som Kusan-risataim mfirinhyia nwɔtwe.
hypothesis: Ɛna adeɛ abufoɔ da yi tia esraeɛ. Na ɔtɔn hɔ nhyɛ mɛso poteamia. Hɛn ekusam resa tem sa. Na esraeɛfoɔ no so kusam resa tem mfimhyia nwɔtwe.

reference: Na sɛ mobisa koraa nso a, mo nsa renka, ɛfiri sɛ, mowɔ adwemmɔne.
hypothesis: Nasɛmubisa koraa nso a wɔn nsa nka afiri sɛ wɔn wɔadwembɔne.

reference: Na ɔsanee sɛ ɔrekɔsa ne ho yadeɛ Yesreel afiri pira a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no, wɔpirapiraa no Rama no mu.
hypothesis: Sane yi sɛ ɔrekɔsa ne ho yɛ adeɛ yi dzerɛ afiri pra a ɔne sere ahen asɔreko no. Wɔapira no rama no mu.

reference: Ɛnna Salomo boaa Israel mpanimfoɔ ne mmusuakuo no atitire ne Israelfoɔ mu agyanom mmapɔmma no ano bɛhyiaa Yerusalem, sɛ wɔrekɔfa AWURADE apam adaka no afiri Dawid kuro a ɛne Sion no mu aba.
hypothesis: Ɛna Salomambɔ a Israel, mpanimfoɔ ne mmusuakuo ne akyitire ne Israelfoɔ mu, egya no mapɔɔma no ano bɛhyia a Yɛresaalam. Saa wɔrekɔfa awuadeɛ apam adaka no afiri dawidi kuro a ɛne seiɛ no mu aba.

reference: Enti Lewifoɔ no siesiee wɔn ara wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ, Aaron mma no deɛ.
hypothesis: Ntilewifoɔ no asiesie wɔn ara wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ ɛrewurɔ ma no deɛ.

reference: Na Samson ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wɔde nhomamono nson a ɛnwoeɛ kyekyere me a, ɛnneɛ mɛhodwo, na mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.
hypothesis: Asamhyɛn kakra no sɛ sɛ wɔde nhoma mono so a ɛno yɛ kyekyere mea ɛne mma wɔdwo na maya sɛ wɔn nipa biara.

reference: Na merenkɔ so mentwe Israel nan mfiri asase a mahyɛ ama wɔn agyanom no so: Hwɛ ara nko na wɔnhwɛ nyɛ adeɛ a mahyɛ wɔn no nyinaa, Mose nsa ano mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ nyinaa.
hypothesis: Maame nkɔsɔmɛntwe adura nnan mfiri asaase a mahyɛ ama wɔn agyanom so. Hyɛranko na wɔn hwɛn nye adeɛ a mahyɛ wɔn no nyinaa. Ma osensanom mmerɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne atabudie nyinaa.

reference: Na wɔsɔre yiyii afɔrebukyia a ɛwowɔ Yerusalem no, na aduhwamhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no nyinaa nso wɔyiyii, na wɔkɔto guu asuwa Kidron mu.
hypothesis: Wɔsɔre yie afɔrebukyia a ɛwowɔ yɛreslɛm no. Na adu hɔnhyia afɔrebukyia no nyinaa nso wɔ yie. Na ɔkɔtɔ gu asua kɛduram.

reference: Salomo kan ahɔhoɔ dodoɔ a wɔwɔ Israel asase so, te sɛ deɛ nʼagya kenkanee nnipa no.
hypothesis: Salemkan ahɔhoa dodoɔ a wɔwɔ edurase ase so te sɛdeɛ n'egya kanee nnipa no.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wode me tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntomaban nwono a.
hypothesis: Ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ sɛɛ ɔde ne tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntoma ban nwoma.

reference: Mʼabusua na ɛyɛ mmerɛ koraa wɔ Manase abusuakuo mu na me na mesua koraa wɔ me fiefoɔ nyinaa mu.
hypothesis: Mmabusua na ɛyɛ mmerɛ koraa wɔ manaasɛ abusua kɔn mu. Na mmena bi nso akoraa wɔ mmofiefoɔ nyinaa.

reference: Na Nebukadnessar yii Yehoiakyin wɔfa Sedekia, sɛ ɔnni ɔhene wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Danabuka ne dza yie wɔɔkye wɔfa sɛdeke a sɛ wɔnni ɔhene wɔwura ne yɛwisale.

reference: Na asase no sofoɔ no faa Yosia ba Yehoahas sii no hene n’agya ananmu Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Asase no sofoɔ no fa yɛn osi aba yɛhu ahasie no ne ne gya anan mu yɛresalam.

reference: Enti, wɔde anigyeɛ kamfoo Awurade, na wɔkoto sɔreeɛ.
hypothesis: Kente, wɔde anigyeɛkaafo aduade na wɔkoto sɔre.

reference: Na ɛno akyiri no ɛbaa Yoas akoma mu sɛ ɔbɛsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ.
hypothesis: Nnan akyire no, ɛbaayewa asaakumaa mu sɛ ɔbasiesie adwurade fie no foforɔ.

reference: Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Usia yɛeɛ no ara.
hypothesis: Ɔyɛ deɛ ɛtene ɛwuradeɛ no so. Sɛdeɛ no agya yɛ ɛno ara.

reference: Ɛnna ɔbarima Lewini a ɔyɛ ɔbaa a wɔdii no awuo no kunu no buaa sɛ: Meduruu Gibea a ɛyɛ Benyamin deɛ no mu, me ne me mpena no, na yɛbɛdaa hɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔbarima lɛɛrini a ɔyɛ ɔbaa a wɔdi no awuo no kunu no boa a sɛɛ, me duruogye beaeɛ bɛn ɛmɛn deɛ no mu. Mɛneɛma mpena no, na yɛbɛda hɔ.

reference: Na asase no so dwoo mfeɛ aduanan.
hypothesis: Nasease no so deɛw mfie adua nan.

reference: Nsuo pa ne nsuo a ɛyɛ nkyenenkyene bɛtumi afiri asutire baako mu aba?
hypothesis: Nsuo pa ne nsuo a ɛyɛ nkyerɛnkyerɛn betumi afiri asutri baako mu aba.

reference: Na ɔfaa asɔfoɔ no ho abufuo no, kwata fifirii ne moma so, asɔfoɔ no anim, AWURADE fie hɔ, aduhwamhyeɛbukyia no ho.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ no ho abufuo no, kwata firi ne moma so. Asɔfoɔ no anim, awurade fie hɔ. Adwuma nhyia bukyia no ho.

reference: Afei, wɔfaa nnadeɛ adwumfoɔ maa wɔde nnadeɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ yɛɛ Awurade Asɔredan no ho nneɛma.
hypothesis: Afoforɔfoɔ anadeɛ dwumfoɔ ma ɔde nnadeɛ ne kɔbrɛn frafra yie aduadeɛ asɔre dan ne ho nneɛma.

reference: Na Hesekia kaa sɛ: Afei moadwira mo ho ama AWURADE, montwe mpini, na momfa okum afɔdeɛ ne aseda afɔdeɛ mmra AWURADE fie.
hypothesis: Bahyɛdzeakyi akase, afei mu adwira mu ho ama awuraade. Mu ntwi mponi, na mu mfa ɔkum afɔdeɛ ne asedafoɔdeɛ mmerɛ awuraade fie.

reference: Na wɔretwentwɛn wɔn nan aseɛ no, Ehud dwanee, na ɔbɛsianee ahoni no ho, na ɔdwane baa Seira.
hypothesis: Wɔn akyerɛnkyerɛn wɔn aseɛ no, ehu dwane na ɔbesiane ahonin no ho. Na odwane baa sia ara.

reference: Enti monyi efi ne bɔne nyinaa nto ntwene, na momfa ɔdwoɔ nnye asɛm a wɔatɛ no mo mu a ɛbɛtumi agye mo kra no.
hypothesis: Ntamu nyi efi ne borɔne nyinaa ntɔn dwene na wɔn mfa wɔdzeɔnye asɛm a wɔata no momu a ebetumi agye mmɔkra no.

reference: Na Huram yɛɛ nsenaa ne sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa no nso.
hypothesis: N'ahoraa mmiɛnsenaa na ɛsefa adeɛ no nkwadaa no so.

reference: Na Yudafoɔ nyinaa gyinagyina AWURADE anim, wɔn ne wɔn mma nketewa, wɔn yerenom ne wɔn mma.
hypothesis: Awidafoɔ nyinaa gyinagyina awuradeɛ anim. Wɔne wɔn man ketewa. Wɔn enum ne wɔn man.

reference: Ɛno enti na Awurade, ne Onyankopɔn, maa Aramhene kwan dii Ahas so nkonim, twaa ne nkurɔfoɔ bebree asuo kɔɔ Damasko no.
hypothesis: Anum tena awurade ne nyɛnko pɔn mu a aara ahwene kwan bi ɛha sononin. Train nkurɔfoɔ bebree, asuo kɔɔ damasko no.

reference: Yotam dii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dunsia wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Yɛtam de mfie adua nunum na ɔbedi hwene. Na ɔde hwene mfie adu nsia wɔ yɛrisa lab.

reference: Na awufoɔ a ɔmaa wɔwuiɛ ne wuo mu dɔɔso sene wɔn a ɔmaa wɔwuiɛ ne nkwa berɛ mu.
hypothesis: Awufo a ɔmo a wɔwii ne wɔn mu dɔɔso sene ɔmo a wɔwii ne kwabiri mu.

reference: Ma memfa enwi no mensɔ menhwɛ prɛko yi bio, ma enwi no nko nwo na obosuo ntɔ ngu fam hɔ nyinaa.
hypothesis: Maame fa ɛwien no nsa ɔmɛn hwɛ prɛko yi bi ho ma ɛwii nko ɛnwɔ na ɔbɔ so ntɔngu fɔm hɔ nyinaa.

reference: “Na wo deɛ, sɛ wodi mʼakyi sɛdeɛ wʼagya Dawid yɛeɛ, na wotie mʼahyɛdeɛ, di me mmara nyinaa so a, meremma obiara mfa wʼahennwa nkɔ.
hypothesis: Wɔdeɛ sɛ wɔdeɛ sɛ wɔdeɛ sɛ wɔdeɛ sɛ wɔdeɛ sɛ wɔdeɛ adeɛ rediɛ na wɔteɛ ma sɛdeɛ deɛ mmirɛ nyinaa so a mmɛɛma obiara mfa wɔn ahenwa nkɔ.

reference: Enti, Awurade maa Asiriafoɔ akodɔm bɛfaa Manase yɛɛ no ɔdeduani.
hypothesis: Nti ɛwadema asɔyafoɔ akɔdɔm bɛfa ama n'ase yɛ no ɔde dua ni.

reference: Na osuo antɔ asase so mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne abosome nsia.
hypothesis: Osuo a ntɔ asase so mfie mmiɛnsa ne abosumayɛ nsia.

reference: Sɛ motumi kyerɛ me aseɛ nnanson apontoɔ yi mu na mohunu a, ɛnneɛ mɛma mo nkamisaa aduasa ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho aduasa; na sɛ moantumi ankyerɛ me a, mo nso momma me nkamisaa aduasa ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho aduasa.
hypothesis: Sɛmɔtumi kyerɛmɛ aseɛ n'aso apom toa yi mu na wɔn mu no a ɛne mmɛma mɔ nkaamisa aduasa ne ntaadeɛ nsa kyerɛ ho aduasa. Na sɛmɔtumi a nkyerɛmɛ a wɔn nso wɔn maame nkaamisa aduasa ne ntaadeɛ nsa kyerɛ ho aduasa.

reference: Me mmuaeɛ ne sɛ, “Kyerɛ me sɛdeɛ obi tumi nya gyidie a nneyɛeɛ mmata ho ase.
hypothesis: Me mu a yɛn sɛ kyerɛm sɛdeɛ obi tumi agyidie a ne yɛ mmata ho ase.

reference: Na ɔsane firi kɔɔ ɔman no mu de firii Beer-seba kɔsii Efraim bepɔ so, na ɔdanee wɔ sane baa AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
hypothesis: Nsane firi kɔ ɔman no mu de firi bɛɛsɛ baako si efiri bepɔ so. Na ɔdane hɔn saa ne ba awura deɛ wɔagya no nyɛ akɔpɔ nkyɛn.

reference: Na afei a AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn atu Amorifoɔ afiri ne man Israel anim yi, wo na wobɛfa adi soɔ anaa?
hypothesis: Naa afei a ɛwuraade srɛɛ nyankopɔ atu abɔwifo afiri ne man srɛɛ no mu yi. Wɔn a wɔbɛfa asase de soa anaa.

reference: ” Enti ɔhene no maa nʼasomfoɔ no nyinaa yɛɛ dinn na ɔmaa wɔn nyinaa firii ɛdan mu hɔ.
hypothesis: Nti, ɔhene no ma n'asofoɔ no nyinaa yɛ din, na wɔn nyinaa afiri dan mu hɔ.

reference: Nna no mu no, na ɔhene biara nni Israel; na nna no mu nso na Danfoɔ abusuakuo no rehwehwɛ agyapadeɛ atena so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛde bɛsi saa berɛ no na agyapadeɛ bi nnya mmɛtɔɔ wɔn fam Israel mmusuakuo no mu.
hypothesis: Nanomu no, na ɔhene bi ani resrae, na nanomu no nso, n'adanfoɔ abusua kuo no rehwehwɛ agyapadeɛ atena so. Mfiri sɛ ɛde besi saa berɛ no na agyapadeɛ bi nyinaa mmɛtɔɔl wɔn fam resrae abusua kuo no mu.

reference: Ɛnna asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no sɔreeɛ na wɔhyiraa ɔman no.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ ne lawifoɔ no so reyɛ. Na wɔhyira ɔman no.

reference: Na wɔtii Midian na wɔde Oreb ne Seeb tiri firi Yordan agya brɛɛ Gideon.
hypothesis: Nauty media, na ɔde ɔreb no sif tiri firi yɛ ɔda ne gya berɛ egu deɛ ɔmo.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wɔde ntampehoma foforɔ a wɔmfa nyɛɛ adwuma da kyekyere me a, ɛnna mɛhodwo mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.
hypothesis: Ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ sɛ ɔde ntaapɛn nhoma foforɔ a wɔn fa ne adwuma da akyekyere mia. Ɛna mehu dwom, maayɛ sɛ ɔnipa biara.

reference: Na Yuda tu kɔe, na AWURADE de Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ no hyɛɛ ne nsa, na wɔkum nnipa mpem du wɔ Besek.
hypothesis: Nayi da tu kɔɔ yi. Na wɔde kɛnamfoɔ ne pɛɛsefoɔ no hyɛ ne nsa. Na wɔkum nnipa mpim do wɔ beseke.

reference: Na Hesekia dii yie ne nneyɛɛ nyinaa mu.
hypothesis: Adzeke ade yie na ne yere nyinaa mu.

reference: Biribiara nni adaka no mu gye aboɔpono mmienu a Mose de guu mu Horeb, faako a AWURADE ne Israelfoɔ pameeɛ berɛ a wɔfiri Misraim asase so reba no.
hypothesis: Bibiaa ne adaka no, mogye aboɔpono mmienu a ɔmo osi de gu mu ɔreba. Faako awuraade ne nsraafoɔ pam yɛ berɛ a wɔfiri ne dze mu asaase ɛreba no.

reference: Ɔdwirii nnuhwam afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Israelman mu nyinaa, na ɔsane kɔɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Odwiri no hɛm afade bukyia a ɛwɔ eduaman no mu nyinaa. Na ɔsan kɔyɛw salad.

reference: Afei, Lewifoɔ no faa Dawid nnwontodeɛ no kɔgyinagyinaa wɔn gyinaberɛ wɔ Asɔredan no ho.
hypothesis: Afei, dawufoɔ no faadeɛ nnwontodeɛ no kɔgyinagyina wɔgyinabrɛ wɔ asɔredan no ho.

reference: Ɛnam Lewi asɔfodie so enti na wɔde Mmara no maa Israelfoɔ.
hypothesis: Wɔnam lewi asɔfodie so wɔn ti na wɔde mmerɛ no maa adzraafoɔ.

reference: Nanso, Yesu deɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ daa na nʼasɔfodwuma no nso, obi ntoa so mma no.
hypothesis: Nnanso yɛsudeɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ daaaaaa. Na n'asɔfo dwuma no nso, obi ntoa so ma no.

reference: Meti mu, ka bio sɛ, ɔman biara nyame ntumi nnyee ne nkurɔfoɔ mfirii me anaa mʼagyanom nsam da.
hypothesis: Me ti mmukabea sɛ ɔman biara nnyɛm ntumi nyeene nkurɔfo mfirim anaa, measure no mu nsam da.

reference: Na gyidie mu na ma no mmisa, na ɔnnnye biribiara ho kyim, ɛfiri sɛ deɛ ɔgye kyim no te sɛ ɛpo asorɔkyeɛ a mframa rebɔ de no redi akɔneaba.
hypothesis: Gyidie mu na manomisa, na ɔnye biribi aho kyim efiri sɛ deɛ ɔgye kyim no te sɛ ɛpo asorɔkyea mframa ɛrebɔ de no ɛredi akɔneaba.

reference: Salomo sii adihɔ maa asɔfoɔ no, sane sii adihɔ kɛseɛ bi wɔ Asɔredan no mfikyire.
hypothesis: Salemɔ si adi hɔ ma asɔfoɔ no sɛn si adi hɔ kɛseɛ bi wɔ asɔredan no mfikyire.

reference: “Na afei, hwɛ deɛ Amonfoɔ, Moabfoɔ ne Seir akodɔm reyɛ.
hypothesis: Aha yi, wɔdeɛ amonfoɔ, mmoafoɔ ne se akodɔm ayi.

reference: Na wɔfefaa wɔn mmammaa warewaree na wɔde wɔn mmammaa memaa wɔn mmammarima awareɛ, na wɔsonsom wɔn anyame.
hypothesis: Ɔfofa ɔma mmaa wɔareware na ɔde ɔma mmaa amemaa ɔma mmarima aware na ɔsonson wɔn ɛnyame.

reference: Sɛ ɔbarima yi anya abɛsoɛ me fie yi, monnni nkwaseasɛm yi.
hypothesis: Saa ɔbarima yi anya abɛsɔm fie yi, mu ne nkɔseɛ asɛm yi.

reference: Ɛsɛe onipadua no nyinaa; ɛsɔ onipa abrabɔ nyinaa so ogya ma ɛdɛre framfram.
hypothesis: Asɛe nnipadua no nyinaa, asɔ nnipa abrabɔ nyinaa so gya ma ɛdɛ refra mfra.

reference: Na ɔsane totoo sorɔnsorɔmmea a n’agya Hesekia bubuiɛ no, na ɔsisii afɔrebukyia maa Baalim, na ɔyɛɛ Asera nnua, na ɔsɔree ɔsoro asafo nyinaa na ɔsom wɔn.
hypothesis: Asan totow sɔn soro mmea a n'agya a edzeki abubu yie no. Osisi afɔrobukyia ma bɛɛlim. Na ɔyɛ asrɛ nnua. Na ɔsɔre ɔsoro asafo nyinaa na ɔsom hɔ.

reference: Na wɔpam ne tiri so, na wɔkɔsii no aboɔ, sɛdeɛ ɔhene hyɛeɛ no AWURADE fie abannwa so.
hypothesis: Wɔapam ne tiri so, na wɔkɔsi n'aboo. Sɛdeɛ ɔhene hyɛ no awuraade fie abaenwa so.

reference: Na wɔkɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ Yuda; na wɔkura AWURADE mmara nwoma no, kyinii Yuda nkuro nyinaa mu, kyerɛkyerɛɛ ɔman no mu.
hypothesis: Ɔkɔkyerɛkyerɛwuda na wokura awuraade mbra nwoma no tsena wuda nkorɔ nyinaa mu. Sra kyerɛ ɔman no mu.

reference: Na ɔsoro adan no nso, ɔde sika kataa ho.
hypothesis: Ɔsoro adan no nso, ɔde sika kata ho.

reference: Ɛberɛ biara a adaka no bɛyɛ ma no, Lewifoɔ no soa de kɔma ɔhene mpanimfoɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛbrebee a adaka no bɛyɛ ma no, laufoɔ no soa de kɔma ɔhene mpanimfoɔ.

reference: Nso wɔn na wɔyeyɛɛ ɔno ne Israel nyinaa suntidua.
hypothesis: Nsuo wɔn a wɔreyɛ ɔno ne ɛsraa nyinaa asɛnti dua.

reference: Mohunu sɛ ɛfiri nnwuma mu na wɔbu onipa bem, na ɛmfiri gyidie nko ara mu.
hypothesis: Mmohunu sɛ efiri nnwuma mu na wɔbu onipa abɛm. Na mfiri gye deɛ nko ara mu.

reference: Ne nna nyinaa mu no, wɔamfiri AWURADE, wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no, akyiridie ho.
hypothesis: Nena nyinaa mu no, wɔn mfiri awuraadeɛ wɔn agya no nyinaa nkopɔn ho akyiri deɛ ho.

reference: Nanso, na asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no sua sɛ wɔbɛtumi asiesie ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no nyinaa enti, wɔn abusuafoɔ Lewifoɔ no boaa wɔn, kɔsii sɛ dwumadie no baa awieeɛ.
hypothesis: Nantena asɔfo a ɔwɔ hɔ no so asɛɛ wɔbetumi asiesie ɔhyɛ afadeɛ no nyinaa ti. Wɔn abusuafoɔ lɔɔfoɔ no baa wɔn. Wɔsiesie dwumadie no baa awieeɛ.

reference: Na ɔkɔhwehwɛɛ Ahasia, na wɔkyeree no, na ɔno deɛ, na ɔde ne ho ahunta Samaria.
hypothesis: Akɔrehwɛ ahaasia na wɔkyerɛ no. Ɔno deɛ na ɔde ne ho ahuta samɛɛla.

reference: Deɛ ɔbɛko ama no no, ma wɔnku no anɔpa; sɛ ɔyɛ onyame a, ma no nko mma ne ho, sɛ wɔaburi n’afɔrebukyia.
hypothesis: Dzea ɔbɛko ama no no ma wɔn kunu anopa. Sɛ ɔreyɛ ndzɛm a ma no nko ma no ho. Saa abruna foɔ rebɔ kyia.

reference: Na Kenini Heber atwe ne ho afiri Kenifoɔ a wɔyɛ Mose akonta Hobab mma na wate mu akɔduru dupɔn a ɛwɔ Saanaim a ɛbɛn Kades no ho akɔsi ne ntomadan.
hypothesis: Naka n'ani ha ba atwe ne ho afiri kanifoɔ a wɔyɛ mosi akontahobabma na wɔate mu akɔduru duku a ɛwɔ saa ne maeɛbɛn kɛdes no ho akɔsi ne ntomadan.

reference: Na yɛbɛtumi aka sɛ, Lewi nso a ɔgye ntotosoɔ du du no nam Abraham so maa ntotosoɔ du du no bi, ɛfiri sɛ berɛ a Melkisedek bɛhyiaa no no, na ɔda so wɔ n’agya asene mu.
hypothesis: Nna yɛbɛtumi aka sɛ lewin so a ɔgye ntotosuo duudu no nam abra aham so ma ntotosuo duudu no bi. Efiri sɛ brown akyi sɛdeɛk bɛhyia ano no na ɔda so wɔ ne gya asene mu.

reference: Ɔhyɛɛ nso sɛ, wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ mma Awurade, sɛdeɛ Mose mmara kyerɛ no, na wɔnto nnwom nsɛpɛ wɔn ho, sɛdeɛ Dawid ahyɛ no.
hypothesis: Ɔhyɛnso sɛ wɔn mu ɔhyɛafoɔ deɛ ma wɔde sɛdeɛ mosua mmira akyerɛ no na wɔn to dwom nsɛpɛ wɔn ho sɛdeɛ dawit ahyɛn.

reference: Ɔno na ɔnkɔdi Gileadfoɔ nyinaa tire.
hypothesis: Ɔno na ɔnkɔdi guilian foɔ nyinaa tiri.

reference: Wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ mmeranteɛ aduasa a wɔfiri kuro no mu sɛ wɔmmɛka ne ho.
hypothesis: Wɔtow sofrɛ mmeranteɛ aduasa a wɔfiri kuro no mu sɛ wɔn mmɛka ne ho.

reference: Na Danfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mma wɔnnte wo nne wɔ yɛn mu, na mmarima a wɔn bo afuo ammɛto anhyɛ mo so, na woanhwere wo nkwa ne wo fiefoɔ deɛ.
hypothesis: Nadanfoɔ no kɛkyerɛ no sɛ ma wɔn te wɔn woyin mu. Na mmarima a wɔn mboafu ama ɛto ahyɛ mu so. Na wɔn ahwiren wɔn kwan ne wɔn fiefuɔ deɛ.

reference: Yefta yɛɛ Israel so ɔtemmufoɔ mfeɛ nsia.
hypothesis: Yɛftaeɛ edwa soɔtamufoɔ mfie nsia. Owuyɛ no, wɔsua no wɔ gylɛd nkuro no baako so. Edziban bɛyɛ edwa so temufoɔ.

reference: Na ɔbarima no sɔree sɛ ɔresim no, n’ase no worɔɔ no, na ɔtenaa ase daa hɔ.
hypothesis: Ɔbarima no sɛ ɔresi mu, na ase no rɔɔ no, na ɔtena asedan hɔ.

reference: Na Isakar mu asafohene kaa Debora ho.
hypothesis: Asa ka mu, asafo no ka dɛbrɛ ho.

reference: Ɛnna Yefta dwane firii ne nuanom nkyɛn kɔtenaa Tob asase soɔ na nnipa ahuhufoɔ bi boaa wɔn ano bɛkaa Yefta ho, na wɔne no firii adi.
hypothesis: Ɛna yɛfita adwane firi ne nuanom nkyɛn kɔtena tɔp asaase soɔ. Na nnipa a wɔwufuo bi bɔ a wɔn ano bɛka yɛfita ho. Na ɔne no frɛdi.

reference: Na AWURADE honhom sii Gideon so, na ɔhyɛn totorobɛnto, na Abi-eserfoɔ hyia bɛdii n’akyi.
hypothesis: Nawurade ho honu si gidioɔn so, na ɔhyɛ atotorobɛnto, na abɛɛsafoɔ hyiaba di n'akyi.

reference: Sɔre, Barak, na fa wo nnommum nnommum.
hypothesis: Sɔre, bag, n'afaw numum numum.

reference: Na obi mfa saa anidie no mma ne ho, gye sɛ deɛ Onyankopɔn afrɛ no te sɛ Aaron no.
hypothesis: Obi mfa saa anidie no ma ne ho. Gyesɛdeɛ onyankopɔn afrɛ no te sɛ ironon no.

reference: Awurade ɔbɔfoɔ no buaa sɛ, “Hwɛ sɛ wo yere bɛdi nhyehyɛeɛ a mekyerɛɛ noɔ no so.
hypothesis: Waadebɔfoɔ no bu asɛ, hwɛ sɛ wɔyiri bɛdi nhwehwɛyɛ a mekyerɛ no no so. Nsesɛ odi bɔbɛsa anaa biribiara a efiri bɔbɛ mu. Nsesɛ ɔno .

reference: ” Enti, wɔyii Yosia firi ne teaseɛnam mu, de no too teaseɛnam foforɔ mu.
hypothesis: Kente wɔyi yɛdzi afiri ne nsa sɛnam mu de no to tse asɛnam foforɔ mu.

reference: Afei, Salomo dwenee sɛ ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsi Awurade Asɔredan no ne nʼankasa nʼahemfie no aso.
hypothesis: Afei soro mu a ɔdwene sɛ ɛbrɛ a ɛsɛsɛ osi awuradeɛ asɔredan no ne n'ankasaa yi fie no asɔ.

reference: Na Gilead mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Yefta sɛ: AWURADE nyɛ yɛne wo ntam danseni; deɛ woseɛ yi, ɛno ara na yɛbɛyɛ.
hypothesis: Guaad mpanimfoɔ no ka kyerɛ yɛftase a awuade no ayɛ ne wɔn ntam danseni. Deɛ wusie yi, ɛnoa na yɛbɛyɛ.

reference: Na ɔbaa n’agya kaa sɛ: Me deɛ, mese wompɛ no bio, enti mede no mama wo yɔnko bi.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa no agya kaasɛ, media, mɛse, ompa no bio, nti mɛde no ama oyɔnko bi.

reference: Yei akyiri no, wɔsiesiee wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ no deɛ, ɛfiri sɛ asɔfoɔ, Aaron mma no wɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ ne sradeɛ no hyeɛ ho ara de kɔsii adesaeɛ.
hypothesis: Iyi akyiri no, wɔasiesie wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ no deɛ. Efir sɛ asɔfoɔ rewuma no wɔ ɔhyia afadeɛ no bɔ ne sradeɛ no hyia no ara de kɔsi adesɛn.

reference: Enti afei ma wɔmpae no ɔman no aso mu sɛ: Deɛ ɔsuro na n’akoma tuo no nsane n’akyi, na ɔnnane n’ani mfiri Gilead bepɔ ho nkɔ.
hypothesis: Ntiafee ma wɔmpae ɔman no asom sɛ deɛ osuo na na kumatuo no nsa n'akyi. Na ɔnane na nimfiri gilaad bepɔ ho rekɔ.

reference: Na Benyamin mmarima mpemdunwɔtwe totɔe; yeinom nyinaa yɛ mmarima akofoɔ.
hypothesis: N'abɛn yɛ mmarima mpemdum atwe totɔɔe. Wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmarima akofoɔ.

reference: Na ɔman no baa Betel bɛtenaa Nyankopɔn anim kɔduruu anwummerɛ, na wɔmemaa wɔn nne so suu su kɛseɛ.
hypothesis: Ɔman no ba abɛtɛ a ɔbɛtena nyankopoɔ anim kɔ dwura nwomrɛ. Na ɔmema wɔn no so susu kɛseɛ.

reference: Na afei AWURADE apo yɛn, na ɔde yɛn ahyɛ Midian nsa.
hypothesis: N'afee ɛwɔ adeɛ apɔn na ɔde ahyɛ media nsa.

reference: Na Yehoiada yii ɔha ha so asafohene a wɔhwɛ dɔm no soɔ no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monyi no mfiri nkɔ nkyerɛpɛn no mu, na deɛ ɔbɛdi n’akyire no, wɔnku no nkrantɛ ano.
hypothesis: Ɛhoa da yi ɔha ha so asafo hene a ɔhwɛ dɔm no soɔ no. Na ɔka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ munin mfir kɔ nkyerɛpɛn no mu. Na deɛ ɔbedi n'akyire no, wɔn kunu nkrataa no.

reference: Nso Odiyifoɔbaa Debora a ɔyɛ Lapidot yere na na ɔbu Israel atɛn saa berɛ no.
hypothesis: Nsuodifoɔ baabi a ɔyɛ lapidɔtere na noa ɔbu nsuo a ɛten saa bere no.

reference: Na Israel somaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Edomhene nkyɛn sɛ: Ma mentwam w’asase so ɛ!
hypothesis: Asraa asumaa abɔ fam a ɔkɔ dɔm hye ne nkyɛn sɛ maame ntwam wɔ asaase soɛ.

reference: Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, ɔman no tuaa nhema sii afɔrebukyia wɔ hɔ, na wɔbobɔɔ hyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ.
hypothesis: Adeɛ kyɛn no, ɔman no tu a nhoma si afa wɔrebɔ kyia wɔ hɔ, na wɔbɔ ahyia afadeɛ ne asomdua afadeɛ.

reference: Na sɛ na Yosua ama wɔn ahome a, anka akyire yi wammɔ da foforɔ din bio.
hypothesis: Abaayewa bi a wɔde reyɛ adeɛ. Na sɛn ayɔsua ama wɔn ahome a ankaa kyerɛ yi, wɔamɔda foforɔ din bi.

reference: Hesekia hyɛɛ Lewifoɔ no nkuran wɔ ɛkwan pa a wɔfa so som Awurade no ho.
hypothesis: Adzi ka ahyɛ alufoɔ no nkran wɔ kwan pa a wɔfa soso ade no ho.

reference: Asa bo fuu Hanani yie sɛ wabɛka saa asɛm yi akyerɛ no, na ɔkyeree no too afiase.
hypothesis: Asabufo hanan yie sɛ wɔabɛka saa asɛm bi akyerɛ no. Na ɔkyerɛ no to afi ase.

reference: Nanso AWURADE ampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe Dawid fie no, apam a ɔne Dawid pameeɛ no nti, ne sɛ ɔkaa sɛ: Ɔbɛma no ne ne mma nso kanea nna nyinaa no.
hypothesis: Nnanso ɛwurade a mpɛ sɛ ɔsɛn dawudifie no apam a ɔne dawudipam yɛn ti ne sɛ ɔka asɛe. Ɔbɛma no ne ne mma nso kanea na nyinaa no.

reference: Wɔakunkum yɛn agyanom wɔ ɔko mu, na wɔakyekyere yɛn mmammarima, yɛn mmammaa ne yɛn yerenom sɛ nneduafoɔ.
hypothesis: Wɔakunkumie gya no wɔ ɔkɔ mu. Na wɔakyekyere yɛma mmarima, yɛma mmaa ne yere no mu sɛn n'aduafoɔ.

reference: Ɛnna Kenaana ba Sedekia twe piniiɛ bɛbɔɔ Mikaia sotorɔ kaa sɛ: Ɛhe na AWURADE honhom nam firii me nkyɛn bɛkasa kyerɛɛ woɔ yi?
hypothesis: Ɛna kene na aba sedeɛ kiatwi pono yi bɛbɔɔl mika yɛ asotorɔka ase. Ɛhene na awuade wɔn honam firi ne nkyɛn bɛkasa kyerɛ ɛwoɔ yi.

reference: Na kerubim no atrɛtrɛ wɔn ntaban mu, adaka no afa no so, na kerubim no kata adaka no ne ɛho mpoma no so ɔsoro.
hypothesis: Naka binom atwerɛtwerɛ wɔn ntaban mu adaka no afa no so. Naka binom no kata adaka no ne ɛho mpoma no so ɔsoro.

reference: Saa ɛberɛ no, ɔbarima bi tenaa Sora a ne din de Manoa a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu.
hypothesis: Saa ɛbrɛ no, ɔbarima bi tena sora a ne din din ma noa a ofiri dan abusua kɔn mu.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: To no din sɛ Yesreel, na aka kakra na mabɛtɔ Yesreel mogya so were Yehu fie, na mama Israel fie ahennie no to atwa.
hypothesis: Ɛwadaka kyerɛ no sɛ tune di nsa yi dze rɛɛl na a aka kakra na ma bɛtɔ yi dze rɛɛl mogya so reyɛ hu fie. Na ma ma yi dze rɛɛl fie aheniɛ no to atwa.

reference: Hwɛ, m’asafo ahodwo Manase mu, na me nso, mene akumaa wɔ m’agya fie.
hypothesis: Hwɛ masafoɔ ahodwuma no asɛ mu. Naame nso, mmenyin a ɛkumaa wɔ measure fie.

reference: Yehoiakyin dii mfeɛ nwɔtwe na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene abosome mmiɛnsa ne dadu wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Yehɔ akyɛn di mfie nwɔtwe na ɔbɛdi adeɛ. Na ɔdi hɛn bosomaa mmiɛnsa ne dɛdu wɔ yɛreslɛm.

reference: Na wɔkan ɔman no, na hwɛ, na Yabes-gileadfoɔ mu biara nni hɔ.
hypothesis: Nna wɔka ɔman no, n'ahwɛ, na yɛabɛs gu-liad foɔ mu biara ani hɔ.

reference: Na ɔhene no ankasa pɛɛ sɛ ɔfiri hɔ ntɛm, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade na wabɔ no.
hypothesis: Ɔhene no ankasa pɛ sɛ ɔfiri hɔ ntam afiri sɛ ade na wabɔ no.

reference: ” Na Abraham wɔ boasetɔ enti, ɛbɔ a Onyankopɔn hyɛɛ no no, ne nsa kaeɛ.
hypothesis: N'abere ha mu wɔ buasetɔnkyi. Ɛba wɔn nyanko pɔn hyɛɛ no no, ne nsa kaeɛ.

reference: Na ɔse: To no din sɛ Lo-ami, na monyɛ me man, na me nso, merenyɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
hypothesis: Nɔɔse tune din sɛ noa mi na mo nyɛ me ma na me nso me nyɛ mu nyɛnko pɔn.

reference: Na ɔfaa bi kura kɔe, na ɔrekorɔ na ɔredi, na ɔkɔduruu n’agya ne ne na nkyɛn, na ɔmaa wɔn bi dii; nanso wanka ankyerɛ wɔn sɛ gyata no yam na ɔyii ɛwoɔ no.
hypothesis: Ɔfra bi kura kɔɔe na ɔkorɔ na ɔredi. Na ɔkɔ duru ne gya no nenam nkyɛn. Na ɔma wɔn bi deɛ, na nso wɔn nkɛntene a ɔhyɛ gyata no yam na ɔyi ɛwoɔ no.

reference: Na Isakar mu asafohene kaa Debora ho.
hypothesis: Asa ka mu, asafo no ka dɛbrɛ ho.

reference: Ɛnyɛ mo deɛ sɛ mobɛko yei mu, gyina nko ara na monkɔgyina, na monhwɛ AWURADE a ɔka mo ho no nkwagyeɛ.
hypothesis: Anyamodeɛ sɛ mmɛbɛko yɛmu gyina nko ara na mmoko gyina. Na mmɔhwɛ awuradeɛ a ɔka wɔn ho no nkwa gyeɛ.

reference: Usia dii mfeɛ dunsia na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ aduonum mmienu wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Nsuadeɛ mfie aduane nsia na ɔbɛdi hwene. Na ɔdi hwene mfie aduane no mmienu wɔ Yɛreslam.

reference: Na sɛ me nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde me din frɛ wɔn no bɛbrɛ wɔn ho ase, abɔ mpaeɛ, ahwehwɛ me, na wɔadane afiri wɔn amumuyɛsɛm ho a, mɛte wɔ ɔsoro, na mede wɔn bɔne akyɛ wɔn, asa wɔn asase yadeɛ.
hypothesis: Asɛm nkurɔfoɔ a wɔde mmidie afiri wɔn no bebree wɔn ho ase abɔ mpaeɛ, ahwehwɛmɛ, na wɔadane afiri wɔn mu mmiɛnsam ho a, mmɛte wɔ ɔsoro, na wɔde wɔn bo no bɛkyɛ wɔn asa wɔn asa ase yɛ adeɛ.

reference: Esiane sɛ na Midianfoɔ no yɛ atirimuɔdenfoɔ enti, Israelfoɔ no dwane kɔɔ mmepɔ so kɔpɛɛ ahintaeɛ wɔ abodan ne atu mu.
hypothesis: Asase no amediafoɔ no yɛ asumadifoɔ nti. Adwadifoɔ no dwa ne kɔn, bepɔ so, kɔpɛɛ, ahintaeɛ wɔ ɔbɔ dan ne ato mu.

reference: Na ɔsisii afɔrebukyia Yerusalem ntwea nyinaa so.
hypothesis: Ma ɔsisi aforo bukyia a yɛresia nam ntwa nyinaa so.

reference: Yosia di Twam afahyɛ.
hypothesis: Ɛtɔ so mmienu, tea deɛ asanom. Wɔsi a yɛde twam afahyɛn.

reference: Na wɔhyɛ Hanania a ɔyɛ ɔhene no mpanimfoɔ no mu baako ase.
hypothesis: Nna wɔhyɛ hannania a ɔyɛ ɔhene no mpanimfoɔ no mu baako ase.

reference: Na ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkɔfrɛɛ Mikaia no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, adiyifoɔ no nsɛm yɛ koro, na ɛyɛ ma ɔhene, na ma w’asɛm nyɛ sɛ wɔn mu baako asɛm, na ka asɛmpa.
hypothesis: Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkɔfrɛ mmikaya no kakra no sɛ hwɛ. Aduifoɔ no nsam yɛ koro, na yɛma ɔhene. Na ma wasɛm anya sɛ wɔn mu baako asɛm, na aka asɛmpa.

reference: Na Hesekia sane brɛɛ ne ho ase n’akoma ahantan no ho, ɔno ne Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa, enti AWURADE abufuo no amma wɔn so Hesekia berɛ so.
hypothesis: Adza kiasa ne berɛ no ho ase na kɔn mu ahantan no ho. Ɔne ne yɛreslɛmfoɔ nyinaa. Nti awuadeɛ foforɔ no ama wɔn so adza kia berɛ so.

reference: Na Lewifoɔ a wɔfiri Kohat ne Kora mmusua mu sɔre gyinaeɛ teaam denden sɔree Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn.
hypothesis: Aleemfoɔ a ofiri koha ne koraa mu so regyina teɛ mu dendenden sɔre awuade. Edwira nye akopɔn.

reference: Na mo nso, mo ne asase yi sofoɔ mmpam apam biara; mommubu wɔn afɔrebukyia!
hypothesis: Namɔnso, wɔn asase yi nsofoɔ mpam apanbea. Wɔn mu bu wɔ n'afo rebɔ kyia.

reference: Moate Hiob boasetɔ no na monim deɛ Awurade de dom no awieeɛ no ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade yɛ ɔdomfoɔ ne mmɔborɔhunufoɔ.
hypothesis: Matehioɔ bobɔ asotɔ no, na wɔn anim deɛ awurade deda mu no awieyɛ no. Efi sɛ awurade yɛ ɔdɔmfoɔ ne muburonfoɔ.

reference: Na Gilead man, wɔn mu atitire sesee wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ: Hwan ne ɔbarima a ɔne Amonfoɔ no bɛfiri aseɛ ako?
hypothesis: Giilad man, wɔn mu a eti tire sisi wɔn ho wɔn ho sɛ kwan ne ɔbarima a ɔne amɔmfoɔ no bɛfiri aseɛ ako.

reference: Na n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, ɔsomaa n’asafohene Ben-hail ne Obadia ne Sakaria ne Netanel ne Mikaia sɛ wɔnkɔ nkɔkyerɛkyerɛ Yuda nkuro mu.
hypothesis: Anaheneɛ afei a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, ɔsomaa a n'asafoɔ hene bɛn hɛl ne ɔbɛdzea ne sakariya ne ne tanea ne mikaeɛ asɛe. Wɔn kɔnkɔ kyerɛkyerɛwii da nkuro mu.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ n’agya bio sɛ: Wɔnyɛ yei mma me; gya me kwan abosome mmienu, na mensiane menkɔ mmepɔ so, na mensu me mmabaaberɛ, me ne me mfɛfoɔ.
hypothesis: Aka kyerɛ ne gya bi ɔsɛɛ, ɔnye yie maame, gyame kwan abɔsumii mmienu, na me nsa ɛmɛkɔ mmepɔ so, na me nsu mmɛma baabre mu, mmɛne mmɛn fɛfoɔ.

reference: Na ne ho hiaa no no, ɔhwehwɛɛ AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn, na ɔbrɛɛ ne ho ase pii wɔ n’agyanom Nyankopɔn anim.
hypothesis: Ɛn ho nyia ano no, ɔhwehwɛ awuraadze nyangopɔn. Na ɔberɛ a ne ho ase pii wɔn agya no nyangopɔn anim.

reference: Yehosafat kaa sɛ, “Nkasa saa.
hypothesis: Yose afat kaasɛ, nkasasa, mayenti asɛm a ɔwɔ ka. Nti, edu ahenfrɛ ne mpanimfoɔ no baako kaakyer no sɛ .

reference: Na ɔbarima efiewura no firii adi kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn hɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Dabi, me nuanom, monnyɛ adebɔne yi!
hypothesis: Ɔbarima efie wura no firi adi kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn, wɔkɔ kyerɛ wɔn sɛɛ, dɛɛ bi ne nua no, wɔn nyinaa de bɔ no yi.

reference: Usia Di Ɔhene Wɔ Yuda.
hypothesis: Oti aduonoo nsia. Wɔdze ade ɔhene wɔwura.

reference: Abɔfoɔ bɛka kyerɛɛ Yehosafat sɛ, “Akodɔm bebree firi Nkyene Po no akyi wɔ Edom rebɛko atia wo.
hypothesis: Abɔfoɔ bɛka kyerɛ yi ɛwɔ safasɛ. Akɔdɔm bebree firi nti ne po no akyi wɔ dɔm rebɛkoatea hɔ.

reference: Na Usia ho nsɛm nkaeɛ, akane deɛ ne akyire yi deɛ no, Amos ba Odiyifoɔ Yesaia atwerɛ.
hypothesis: Abusia ho asɛm kaeɛ. Akanea ne ɛkyɛ yi deɛ no, ɛma ɔdze ba odiefoɔ a yɛsia atwerɛ.

reference: Na ɔman no nyinaa, Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu mpanimfoɔ no, bɛgyinaa Nyankopɔn man dwabɔ no mu, wɔyɛ mmarima mpemahanan a wɔnam anammɔn mu a wɔtwe nkrantɛ.
hypothesis: Ɔman no nyinaa, ɛsraa amusuakuo nyinaa mu mpanimfoɔ no, bɛgyina nyankopɔnman dwabɔ no mu. Wɔyɛ mmarima mpemmaa hɛn nan a wɔnam anamɔmoa a wɔtwe nkranteɛ.

reference: Ɛnna Salomo kaa sɛ: AWURADE aka sɛ ɔbɛtena sum kusuu mu.
hypothesis: Ɛna Salomma kaa sɛ awuradeɛ akɛseɛ ɔbɛtena sum kusuu mu.

reference: Na AWURADE diyifoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ne din de Oded.
hypothesis: Nna awuradidiefoɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ne dende ɔdɛd.

reference: Ɛsɛ sɛ saa onipa no frɛ asafo mpanimfoɔ na wɔde Awurade din bɔ mpaeɛ ma no na wɔsra no ngo.
hypothesis: Ɛsɛsɛɛsɛɛ nnipa no frɛ asafo mpanimfoɔ na wɔde awura ade di rebɔ mpaeɛ ma no na wɔsra no.

reference: na me nso menya ntadeɛ a ɛkura ahosuo ahodoɔ na wɔanwono mu fɛɛfɛ.
hypothesis: Maame nso manya ntaadeɛ a ekura ahosuo ahodoɔ na ɔmo enwunu mu fɛɛfɛ.

reference: Na adɛn enti na afei woaba sɛ wo ne me rebɛko?
hypothesis: Adan tsena afei, waba sɛ wɔn mmiribɛko.

reference: Na Manase ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ne ne mpaeɛ a ɔbɔɔ ne Nyankopɔn ne adehunufoɔ a wɔde AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn din kasa kyerɛɛ no no nsɛm no, hwɛ, ɛwɔ Israel Ahemfo ho Nsɛm no mu.
hypothesis: Amanaase ho asɛm kaa ne ne mpaeɛ a ɔbɔɔl ne nea nkɔpɔɔl ne ade honuufoɔ a wɔde awura ade nsira nkɔpɔɔl de rekasa kyerɛ no nsam no. Hwɛ ɛwɔ nsiraeɛfo nsɛm no mu.

reference: Ɛberɛ a ɔsɔfoɔ no hunuu sɛ mmarima no retwe akronkronneɛ no afiri Mika asɔreeɛ hɔ no, ɔbisaa wɔn sɛ, “Ɛdeɛn na moreyɛ yi?
hypothesis: Berɛ a asɔfo no hu sɛ mmarima no retwe akronkroniɛ no afiri mirika asɔreɛ hɔ no. Obisa wɔn sɛ, ɛde nambɔ reyɛ.

reference: Ɛyɛ sɛ modi yɛn Awurade mmara a ɛka sɛ, “Dɔ wo yɔnko sɛ wo ho” no so.
hypothesis: Ayaasamudi yɛn nwura de mmra a ɛka sɛ dɔn yɔnko sɛ wohunu so.

reference: Mo ahonya no aporɔ na nweweboa awe mo ntoma.
hypothesis: M'ahonya no aprɔ na nwɛwɛboa awɛ mu ntoma.

reference: Na ɔnantee Israel ahemfo akwan so, na ɔyɛɛ guo ahoni nso maa Baalim.
hypothesis: Nɔnante edzraa mfoɔ akwan so. Nɔyɛ eguo ahoɔni so ma bɛɛlim.

reference: Na Usia wɔ asraafoɔ a wɔyɛ akofoɔ akɛseɛ a wɔwɔ akodie mu nteteeɛ.
hypothesis: Nna ɔgyia wɔ asraafoɔ a ɔyɛ akofoɔ akɛseɛ a ɔwɔ akodeɛ mu teteɛ.

reference: Ɔde ne nyinaa guu ne mmatire so, soa de kɔɔ bepɔ bi a ɛne Hebron di nhwɛanimu no atifi.
hypothesis: Ɔde ne nyinaa gu ne mɛtiri so, soa de kɔ bepɔ bi a ɛne hebrɔde nhwɛni mu no atifi.

reference: Na afei, AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn, kora deɛ woka kyerɛɛ w’akoa, m’agya Dawid, no so ma no, sɛdeɛ wokaa sɛ: Wɔremma onipa mmɔ no w’anim a ɔbɛtena Israel ahennwa soɔ.
hypothesis: N'afee awuade, edzirae nyanko pɔn. Koraa deɛ wɔka kyerɛ wakowa, magya devid no so ma no. Saa deɛ wɔka asɛ, wɔn a onipa amɔ no wɔ anim a ɔbɛtena edzirae n'enyiwa so.

reference: Na asɔfoɔ no ne Lewifoɔ sɔre hyiraa ɔmanfoɔ no, na Onyankopɔn tiee wɔn firi ne soro atenaeɛ kronkronbea hɔ.
hypothesis: Asɔfoɔ ne yɛlɛifoɔ no sɔre hyira ɔmanfoɔ no. Na onyankopɔntie wɔn firi ne soro atene a yɛ kononbea hɔ.

reference: Na wo babarima no bɛyɛ obi a wɔayi no asi hɔ ama Onyankopɔn sɛ Nasareni firi awoɔ mu kɔsi ɛberɛ a ɔbɛwu.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa barima no bɛyɛ obi a wayi no asi hɔ ama onyanko pɔn sɛ n'adzerɛni afiri awoɔ mu kɔsi ɛbrɛ a ɔbɛwɔ.

reference: Filistifoɔ ntuanofoɔ kɔɔ ɔbaa no nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, “Hwɛ sɛ wobɛtumi adaadaa Samson ma wakyerɛ wo deɛ ɛma ɔnya ahoɔden saa ne sɛdeɛ yɛbɛtumi adi ne so, akyekyere no pampee.
hypothesis: Folitifoɔ ntoanofoɔ kɔ ɔbaa no nkyɛ kɔkakyɛ no sɛ. Hwɛ sɛ wɔbetumi adaadɛsɛm so. Ma wɔakyere wɔdeɛ ma onya ahoɔden saa ne sɛdeɛ ebɛtumi di ne so akyekyere no pampe.

reference: Wɔn a wɔfiri Merari abusua mu no ne: Abdi babarima Kis ne Yehalelel babarima Asaria.
hypothesis: Wɔn a wɔfiri mmarahyɛ abusua mu adi bɛrima kese. Ne yɛ ha lɛɛlɛ bɛrima asaareɛ.

reference: Ɛfiri sɛ, adefoɔ no twam kɔ sɛ wiram afifideɛ bi.
hypothesis: Efi sɛ adefoɔ no twam kɔ sɛ nwiram afifidie bi.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn hɔ no dii Twam no berɛ no mu, ne apiti nnapɔnna no nnanson.
hypothesis: Adwadifoɔ a wɔhunu wɔn hɔ no di twam no brim no mu. Ne apiti n’apɔn nan so.

reference: Na hwɛ, na Barak reti Sisera; na Yael firii adi kɔhyiaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Bra na menkyerɛ wo ɔbarima a worehwehwɛ no no.

hypothesis: Sie yie so wɔ asase so a anka ɔnnyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ koraa efiri sɛɛ. Asɔfoɔ wɔ hɔ a wɔde aforo bɔ deɛ ma sɛdeɛ wida foɔ mmerɛ akyerɛ no.

reference: Enti, wɔde too Yudafoɔ ne Yerusalemfoɔ anim sɛ, wɔmfa ɛtoɔ a Mose, Onyankopɔn ɔsomfoɔ gyegyee Israelfoɔ wɔ ɛserɛ so no mmrɛ Awurade.
hypothesis: Edziwaadetewwidafoɔ ne yellow saladfoɔ anim sɛ wɔn fa ɛtoɔ a mosi onya nkopɔnsofoɔ gyeyɛ edwurafoɔ wɔ ɛhyɛ no so mmerɛwura ade.

reference: Ɛnyɛ adefoɔ no na wɔhyɛ mo soɔ, na wɔn ara twe mo kɔ asɛnniiɛ anaa?
hypothesis: Nyaadefoɔ no na wɔhyɛ mu soɔ, na wɔatwem kɔ aseneɛ anaa.

reference: Na Salomo hyɛɛ aseɛ sii Awurade Asɔredan no wɔ Yerusalem Moria bepɔ so a ɛhɔ na Awurade yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Salomo agya Ɔhene Dawid no.
hypothesis: Salam a ɔhyɛ ase asi asi aduadeɛ asɔredan no wɔ Yɛr salam. Mɔwura bepɔ so a ɛhɔ na aduadeɛ yi ne ho adi kyerɛ salam gya ɔhene dawid no.

reference: Nanso sorɔnsorɔmmea no deɛ, wanyi, na ɔman no nnya nsiesiee wɔn akoma mmaa wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no.
hypothesis: Nsosɔnsoɔ mmea no deɛ, wɔn ani. Na ɔman no nyɛa nsiesie wɔ akomaa mu ma wɔagya no nyɛa nkɔpɔɔ no.

reference: Na ɔwɔ adwuma bebree Yuda nkuro mu, na akofoɔ, mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho, Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Naa ɔwɔ adwuma bebree yi da nkuro mu. Na akofoɔ mmarima a wotumi wɔn ho yɛresa dɛm.

reference: Na Nun ba Yosua, AWURADE akoa no wui, na wadi mfirinhyia ɔha ne du; na wɔsiee no n’agyapadeɛ hyeɛ so wɔ Timnat-heres, Efraim bepɔ so, Gaas bepɔ atifi fam.
hypothesis: N'ano nnumayɛ osua. Awurade akɔ a no wui na wɔde mfirihyia wɔ ha no do. Na osie no na agyapadeɛ ahyia nso wɔ temnat hɛɛs efiri mmepɔ so. Gars bepɔ atifi fam.

reference: Gilead te Yordan agya; na Dan deɛ, adɛn nti na ɔne ahyɛn teɛ?
hypothesis: Gyaleate yɔda na gya, na dandeɛ, adeɛntene a ɔne ahyɛn tie.

reference: Na Nyankopɔn bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Fa nam no ne apiti no gu ɔbotan a ɛwɔ ha yi so, na ɛho nsuo no, hwie gu.
hypothesis: Yɛn akɔmmɔfoɔ no kakra no sɛ, fanam no ne apiti no gu ɔbotan a ɛwɔ ha yi so. Na ɛho nsuo no, twiagu.

reference: Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu Yehosafat no, wɔkaa sɛ: Israel hene no nie!
hypothesis: Nanteaseɛnam so asafoɔ hɛn no ho yɛhɛ osa faat no. Ɔka asɛe, idura hɛn no nie.

reference: Na mosu frɛɛ me no, megyee mo firii wɔn nsam.
hypothesis: Abusu frɛɛm no, mbɛgyinamu firi wɔn nsam.

reference: Ɛberɛ a Asaria ne asɔfoɔ a aka no hunuu kwata no, wɔpiapiaa no firii hɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛbera asa awea ne asɔfoɔ a aka no hunu kata no. Wɔapirapira no firi hɔ.

reference: Ɔhene Salomo yii wɔn mu ahanu aduonum maa wɔkɔhwɛɛ ne nkɔsoɔnnwuma so.
hypothesis: Ɔhene sɛlɔm yi, wɔn mu, ahɛnua dua no mu, wɔrekɔhwɛ ne nkosuo nnwuma so.

reference: Agyanom atitire a wɔwɔ mmarima akofoɔ no mu no nyinaa ano si mpennu ahansia.
hypothesis: Agyanom akyi tiri a ɔwɔ mmarima akofoɔ no mu no nyinaa ano si mpanu ahenseɛ.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Gideon sɛ: Mmarima ahasa a wɔtafereeɛ no na mede bɛgye mo, na mede Midian mahyɛ wo nsa, na ma wɔn a aka no mu biara nkɔ ne tenabea.
hypothesis: Nnɛɛade kakra a wɔde wɔn sɛ mmarima a wɔta frɛ no na wɔde bɛgye mu. Na wɔde media mahyɛ wɔn nsa. Na ma wɔn a aka no mu biara akɔ ne tsenabea.
